About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Job Purpose

Fanatics Collectibles is hiring an Associate, People Intelligence to help grow an AI-native people intelligence function. This hands-on, high-impact role sits at the intersection of workforce analytics, data, AI, systems, and process automation, turning people data into decisions and building practical tools and workflows that improve how HR and the business operate.

The ideal candidate pairs strong analytical ability with an AI-native, builder-oriented working style. You should have experience writing SQL; connecting, structuring, and validating data from multiple sources; translating data into a clear story; and using AI to accelerate analytical, technical, and operational work. You will help build internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, dashboards, automations, and repeatable workflows that make people data and People processes easier to use.

You will also design and operate AI-agent workflows, connect AI and automation safely to sensitive people data and enterprise systems, strengthen data, application, and process governance, and partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to simplify, standardize, and automate programs. Success requires the ability to solve ambiguous problems, carry improvements from discovery through implementation, and maintain a team-first mindset. This is a small team with meaningful scope, where you will own work from day one and help shape how the function operates.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain analyses, dashboards, reports, and AI-powered intelligence experiences that answer meaningful workforce questions—including retention, hiring-pipeline health, skills gaps, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, and employee experience—and give HR, Recruiting, Finance, and business leaders self-service access to reliable, actionable insights.Write SQL to connect, structure, and validate people data across source systems, Snowflake, and downstream tools; support governed data models and data lake and data warehouse environments; and resolve data-quality issues at the root cause.Design, build, test, document, and maintain internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, AI-agent and automation workflows, prototypes, and self-service experiences that make people data and processes intuitive, secure, repeatable, and auditable.Partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to map and improve end-to-end programs, reducing manual effort, duplicate entry, unnecessary handoffs, control gaps, and employee or manager friction through automation, standardization, and streamlined design.Create and maintain current- and future-state process and data maps, source-to-target mappings, system and data-flow diagrams, data dictionaries, ownership documentation, standard operating procedures, and related technical documentation.Support data, process, and application governance across sensitive people data, AI-enabled solutions, Oracle HCM, workforce-planning platforms, reporting environments, and automation tools—including access, responsible data handling, lineage, quality controls, ownership, requirements, testing, change control, release documentation, issue management, and auditability.Partner with HR, Employee Lifecycle, Finance, business, and technical stakeholders to translate needs into prioritized improvement opportunities and maintain a transparent roadmap across analytics, systems, applications, automation, and process improvement.

What You Bring

1–3+ years of experience in data, analytics, business systems, HR systems, process improvement, automation, or a related technical or analytical role.Proficiency in SQL, with foundational knowledge of data modeling, data structures, and how information moves across systems.Hands-on experience using AI tools, agents, or AI-assisted workflows—such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms—to complete analytical, technical, or operational work.Experience building or prototyping internal tools, automations, Web App-based experiences, or deliverables using code, low-code/no-code platforms, or AI-assisted development.Experience mapping and documenting processes, data flows, system interactions, requirements, controls, and ownership, with a foundational understanding of data privacy, security, role-based access, quality, and governance.Demonstrated ability to identify issues in data, systems, or workflows; carry improvements from problem definition through testing and implementation; and translate stakeholder needs into workable solutions across technical and non-technical teams.Comfort operating in a fluid, fast-moving environment where processes, tools, and standards are still being built, with strong attention to detail and a habit of validating outputs.Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, Organizational Behavior, Computer Science, or another relevant quantitative, technical, or social science field.

KEY TRAITS WE VALUE

AI-native — uses AI tools to move faster and do more, understands their limitations, and has informed opinions about where AI does and does not add value.Product-minded builder — translates ambiguous business problems into simple, usable tools and workflows, improves them based on feedback, and follows through beyond launch.Systems and governance mindset — understands how data, processes, systems, controls, and decisions connect and moves quickly without sacrificing security, quality, documentation, appropriate access, or process discipline.Technically self-sufficient — can take work from data pull or problem definition through testing, documentation, and clean output, with appropriate support and escalation.Curious about people, not just data — wants to understand what the numbers, systems, and process outcomes mean for employees, managers, and the organization.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Description

WHO WE ARE

Mojo Supermarket is a fully integrated agency built on the creative philosophy "Break your Brain Good." We create work that rewires the way people think and helps brands solve their biggest business challenges. By combining strategic thinking with bold creative, we deliver ideas that generate outsized business results for clients including TikTok, Burger King, Chase, DoorDash, Ruggable, and more.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Analyst, Data & Analytics who is curious about what data can tell us about people, brands and the work we make — and who knows that the job doesn’t stop at reporting the numbers.

You’ll work across campaign, social, platform and audience data to understand what’s happening, dig into why it’s happening and help turn those findings into clear stories and recommendations for our Strategy, Creative, Account and Social teams.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of room to grow. You’ll build analyses and reporting, work directly with teams and clients, and help us continue developing how Data & Analytics shows up across the agency.

We don’t expect you to arrive having done everything on this job description. We care most about strong analytical instincts, curiosity, clear communication and the ability to learn quickly. If you have a solid foundation in marketing analytics and want to broaden into areas like social intelligence, creator measurement, audience insights and creative effectiveness, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Pull, organize and analyze data across campaigns, platforms, audiences, social/content and other relevant sources.  Build reports, dashboards and analyses that make complicated information easy to understand and useful.  Look beyond what happened to investigate why it happened, what it means and what we should do next.  Identify trends, anomalies, audience behaviors, performance gaps and opportunities.  Turn findings into clear insights and recommendations for Strategy, Creative, Account, Social and clients.  Partner closely with Strategy and Creative to connect data to briefs, ideas, content, testing and future decisions.  Help teams understand how work is performing — and where the data may challenge an assumption or point toward a better question.  Contribute to client conversations and grow your ability to present and defend analytical findings.  Help develop measurement approaches for accounts and campaigns alongside Strategy leadership.  Work with and continue building fluency across areas such as social/content analytics, social listening, audience intelligence and creator measurement.  Maintain accuracy and consistency across reporting and data sources. 

Requirements

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

2+ years of experience in analytics, marketing analytics, media analytics, measurement, research, insights or a related discipline.  Hands-on experience working with quantitative marketing or audience data.  Strong analytical instincts and a desire to understand the story behind the numbers.  The ability to move from data → insight → recommendation, not simply report performance.  Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can explain complicated information in plain English.  Experience in at least one relevant area such as campaign analytics, paid social/digital analytics, audience analysis, social/content analytics or marketing measurement.  Comfort working with data in tools such as Excel/Sheets, dashboards, analytics platforms or comparable environments.  Curiosity about brands, advertising, social media, culture and creative work.  A collaborative mindset and an interest in working closely with Creative, Strategy, Account and Social.  Enough confidence to form a point of view — and enough curiosity to change it when the data tells you something new.  A willingness to learn capabilities you may not have worked with yet.

NICE TO HAVE

Agency or client-facing marketing experience.  Experience presenting findings or recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders.  Experience with social listening, audience-intelligence or creator-measurement platforms.  Familiarity with tools such as Meltwater, GWI, Tubular, Brandwatch, Sprinklr or comparable platforms.  Dashboard-building experience.  SQL, Python or other analytical/automation skills.  Experience analyzing creative or content performance.

What Success Looks Like

You produce reliable analysis, but you’re also developing a reputation for finding the interesting thing in the data.You ask good questions, spot patterns other people may miss and can explain why a finding matters without burying the team in numbers.Strategy, Creative, Account and Social teams trust you as a thought partner, not simply the person who produces the report.Over time, you expand your fluency across social, audience, creator and measurement disciplines and take on increasingly complex analytical questions.Most importantly, your work helps Mojo make better-informed creative, strategic and business decisions.

WORKING MODEL

Mojo operates on a hybrid working model, with our team together in our New York City office Tuesday through Thursday.

Benefits

Competitive salary401(k) with up to a 4% company matchMedical, dental, and vision insuranceFlexible paid time off Paid parental leave Culture & wellness StipendFive-week paid sabbatical for employees with five years of serviceTwice monthly team mealsPre-tax commuter benefits

Our Performance Marketing team drives scalable and predictable revenue growth. As part of our team, you'll be surrounded by bright minds and keen collaborators — always willing to help and be helped — as you apply passion to work that will compel our audience to choose IBM's products and services.

About Orchestra

Orchestra is a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at www.orchestraco.com.

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

About This Role

Orchestra is looking for an Analytics Specialist to play a key role in the growth and evolution of our Strategic Insights team. We want someone energized by the opportunity to deliver thoughtful, high-impact analyses that help our clients make data-driven decisions.

This person should bring a strong foundation in analytics tools and a passion for creating compelling reports that support the agency’s insights deliverables. They will have the chance to work across agencies and client verticals, applying rigorous methodologies and translating findings into clear strategic implications that resonate with our clients. Above all, this person will be intellectually curious, motivated, and excited by the possibilities of what can be measured, learned, and achieved through data.

Role location: This role may be remote in the U.S., with a preference for candidates based in New York, N.Y., or Washington, D.C. Employees in NYC or D.C. are considered hybrid and are expected to be in-office three days per week.

Accountabilities & Qualifications

As an Analytics Specialist, you will:

Join a growing team of innovative analytics professionals, delivering interesting and impactful data-driven insights to a vast range of clientsWork collaboratively with various teams across the agency network to support analytics & insights needs, applying data-driven best practices to support each client’s unique objectivesSupport the execution of research projects including: desk research, designing Boolean search taxonomies, media and social media analysis, white space assessments, audience intelligence, and much moreSupport the production of reports and analysis for clients & interagency stakeholders to support data-backed findings and strategic recommendationsExecute comprehensive measurement plans for analyzing owned, social, and earned propertiesAssist in business development and growth by working with an interagency team to inform our proposal strategy through insights deliverablesWork closely with colleagues across the Strategic Insights team to execute research strategies (e.g., methodology selection, data capture, data visualization, and storytelling)Keep up to date on best practices, tools and news in the analytics industryHave an interest in working with cutting-edge tools and research methodologies, leveraging powerful new mediums like AI to make analysis more efficient and impactful

Essential Skills

1–3 years of full-time workplace experience; relevant internships in media monitoring and media analysis will be considered on a case-by-case basis Strong technical research methodology skills and a solid understanding of data collection best practices and toolsSelf-starter mindset with a strong sense of ownership, independence, and accountabilityProficiency in Excel or Google Sheets Familiarity with deck production, data visualization, and presentation toolsProven ability to manage multiple analysis projects simultaneously within a fast-paced, detail-oriented environmentStrong data collection, interpretation, and analytical skills

Preferred Skills

Experience supporting integrated marketing, communications or digital campaigns in an agency, consultancy or in-house environmentExperience leveraging media monitoring and social listening tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Brandwatch, Meltwater)Experience with audience intelligence tools (e.g., GWI, MRI Simmons, Stat Social, YouGov, Statista)Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau and LookerCuriosity and engagement when analyzing complex or technical datasetsStrong digital storytelling abilities

WORKING AT ORCHESTRA

Orchestra is the first communications company built for today’s media landscape. Since 2022, it’s acquired nine firms, including: BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. rows.descriptionText:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is seeking a Senior Associate, Customer Marketing to help execute lifecycle marketing strategies for FanDuel Predicts, driving engagement and long-term customer value across every stage of the customer journey from onboarding and activation through retention and re-engagement. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll bring lifecycle campaigns to market, analyze performance, and identify opportunities to optimize the customer experience. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining data-driven insights with creative thinking to deliver personalized campaigns that improve customer engagement and business outcomes while continuing to grow as a lifecycle marketer.

This is a role sits at the intersection of strategy and operations. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on operational excellence - diagnosing customer behavior problems, developing data-driven hypotheses, designing and optimizing customer journeys, orchestrating promotional and communications campaigns, and continuously improving based on learnings. You'll think independently, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities to improve reactivation, retention, and customer lifetime value. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on ownership, combines analytical rigor with creative problem-solving, and wants to meaningfully shape how FanDuel connects with and grows its customer base.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

Contribute to the development and execution of core lifecycle marketing strategies across retention, monetization, and re-engagement stages using advanced segmentation, leveraging communication and promotional capabilities.Identify gaps and opportunities to improve key metrics, develop business cases, and partner with Marketing leadership to shape roadmap priorities.Execute end-to-end campaigns at scale. Ensure flawless execution and own ongoing performance monitoring and reporting.Partner with Commercial, Analytics, Product, and CRM Operations to identify lifecycle initiatives and recommend improvements based on customer insights.Build and maintain customer audiences and segments using behavioral and transactional data to deliver more relevant customer experiences.Identify experimentation opportunities to improve core metrics. Develop hypotheses, design A/B tests and multivariate experiments, partner with Analytics to understand impact, and scale learnings.Translate data into compelling stories that drive action. Monitor campaign performance and customer behavior to identify optimization opportunities and improve lifecycle journeys.Drive personalization and automation by leveraging real-time signals to deliver the right message, at the right time, through the right channel.Collaborate with marketing technology and data teams to enhance automation capabilities, audience targeting, and measurement frameworks.Partner on market insights, data science, and product roadmaps to improve lifecycle outcomes and deepen understanding of customer behavior.Leverage strong expertise in lifecycle marketing best practices, influencing broader marketing, product, and promotional strategies across the business.Continuously evaluate campaign performance and customer behavior to iterate on strategies that increase retention, engagement frequency, and overall customer lifetime value.Leverage AI strategically. Use modern tools to enhance analysis and productivity while maintaining critical thinking and attention to detail.


THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

3+ years’ experience in marketing, commercial, or similar.Fundamental understanding of marketing platforms, Email Service Providers, and Customer Data Platform Technologies.Deep knowledge of sports betting, prediction markets, iGaming, or online gaming—demonstrated through active use and/or direct work experience.Strong understanding of marketing and commercial metrics.Strong design thinking skills and effective at project management.Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver projects and campaigns.Highly organized with acute attention to detail and ability to prioritize and execute on multiple projects across various stakeholders.Results oriented and metrics driven, with the need to be objective and measure performance.Strong analytical approach to decision making with experience of delivering against business outcomes.Collaborative team player, proactive thinker, and pragmatic problem-solver.Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changes quickly.Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.Knowledge of sports, casinos, culture, politics, and/or experience working within a heavily regulated industry is a plus.Willing to work some non-traditional hours.

What Success Looks Like

We're a member-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. Opportunities to stretch and grow: your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on-the-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards.

About Us

Harlem Grown is an independent, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization whose mission is to inspire youth to lead healthy and ambitious lives through mentorship and hands-on education in urban farming, sustainability and nutrition. We operate local urban farms, increase access to and knowledge of healthy food for Harlem residents, and provide farm-based development programs to Harlem youth.

Founded in 2011 by Tony Hillery with one school partnership, one urban farm and an idea to help Harlem children, today Harlem Grown's farms and greenhouses are used as classrooms and as venues to cultivate a connection to the environment and food among young people. Harlem Grown operates 14 urban agricultural sites featuring soil-based urban farms, hydroponic greenhouses, and a mushroom chamber. All of our sites are located between 122nd and 152nd Streets in Central Harlem, Manhattan.

Our Programs

Harlem Grown cultivates deep community roots by growing fresh food, strong youth, and lasting relationships. We meet children where they live, learn, and grow—offering opportunities that extend beyond our farms to the classroom and into their futures. Through Food and Farm Education, we help youth build healthy habits, leadership skills, and a deeper connection to their community. Our urban farms provide free produce and nutritious meals for families while creating joyful spaces for connection and support. Through 14 urban farms and year-round programming, we provide free produce, nutritious meals, and cooking lessons while creating joyful spaces for connection and support. In addition, our programs increase economic opportunity for families and develop leadership and advocacy skills so participants can drive transformational change in their communities.

At Harlem Grown, we grow healthy children and communities through hands-on education, access to resources, and long-term youth support. Our Food and Farm Education —including summer camp, in-school and after-school programs, mobile education, service learning, and farm tours—delivers farm-based lessons to children in our community. We offer free community resources like farmstands, Saturdays on the farm, and events that provide fresh food and create spaces for support and connection. Through academic support, internships, and career readiness programs, we help our young people build confidence and skills to thrive from elementary school through adulthood.

Modality: On-site

Position type: Full-time

We are currently hiring for multiple positions. Position level and placement will be determined based on each candidate's qualifications, experience, and overall fit for the organization.*

rows.title: Global Supply Chain Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
The Impact You'll Make

As a Data Scientist – Demand Planning Analytics, you will help shape smarter supply chain decisions by transforming data into actionable insights that improve forecast accuracy, identify emerging demand shifts, and strengthen customer delivery performance. Your work will directly support informed planning and decision-making across a rapidly growing business.

You will develop analytics, forecasting models, and demand insights that help the organization anticipate risk earlier, reduce uncertainty, and respond more effectively to changing customer needs. By improving visibility into order patterns and demand signals, you will help teams make confident decisions that balance customer expectations and operational realities.

Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, collaboration, and the ability to translate complex findings into meaningful business actions. You will work across functions, lead through influence, embrace continuous improvement, and demonstrate the Danfoss behaviors while fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives contribute to better outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing
Develop demand forecasting models and analytical methods/tools that improve forecast accuracy, bias visibility, and exception management. Analyze customer order book quality, order changes, cancellations, pull-ins, pushouts, abnormal demand signals, and forecast volatility. Build demand-risk dashboards, alerts, and scenario views to support SIOP, S&OE, and customer escalation discussions. Partner with the SIOP & S&OE / Demand Planning Leader to translate model outputs into practical planning actions. Support segmentation logic by product family, line of business, customer, region, volume, volatility, and service impact. Collaborate with IT/data teams to define source-data requirements, governed datasets, data quality checks, and refresh logic. Validate model performance, document assumptions, monitor drift, and improve model reliability over time. Convert complex analytical findings into clear explanations for planners, materials managers, OFRs, and leadership. Support process improvements that reduce manual reporting, improve decision speed, and strengthen demand planning standard work. Maintain documentation for models, metrics, data definitions, and user guidance. 

What We're Looking For
Experience developing forecasting, statistical, machine learning, or business analytics solutions that drive operational decision-making. Strong skills in data analysis, data modeling, visualization, and communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Proficiency with analytics and data tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, or similar platforms used to generate business insights. Understanding of demand planning, forecasting, supply chain operations, or related business processes where analytics support planning decisions. Demonstrated ability to influence across teams, solve problems collaboratively, and embody the Danfoss behaviors through inclusive leadership and continuous improvement. 

What You'll Get From Us
The opportunity to influence strategic supply chain decisions through advanced analytics and data-driven insights. Exposure to cross-functional and global stakeholders, enabling you to expand both your business and technical expertise. A collaborative and inclusive environment where innovation, curiosity, and diverse perspectives are encouraged. Opportunities for professional development through complex analytical challenges, continuous learning, and global career growth. The chance to help build more resilient, responsive, and customer-focused supply chain capabilities through data and technology.  Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. rows.title: Executive Services Program Manager

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

We're looking for a personal security program manager to support a fast-growing GSIS (Global Safety, Intelligence & Security) function. Reporting to the Protective Service Senior Manager, and working within the broader direction the Protective Services Lead sets, this role sits at the intersection of corporate security fundamentals and program management execution. You'll execute a defined slice of the policies, processes, and reporting that let the function scale, working within scope your manager sets rather than defining that scope yourself, and you'll support cross-functional projects of low to moderate complexity.

This is not a purely administrative role. You'll need enough security domain grounding to work credibly alongside experienced practitioners, enough program discipline to execute reliably against a defined plan, and enough judgment to know when to flag something up rather than push forward on your own. Most of what you touch will already have a framework your manager has set; your job is to execute cleanly within it and surface what needs a decision above your level.

Responsibilities

Maintain the policy and procedure library for your assigned GSIS sub-domain, following the framework your manager sets, flagging gaps rather than resolving them unilaterallySupport the GSIS metrics and reporting framework for your assigned scope: pull together operational health and status updates on a defined cadenceExecute assigned tasks in the build-out of net-new capabilities, under close direction from the Senior Manager or Lead; contribute to documentation and training materialsAct as first point of contact for lower-complexity stakeholder requests within your assigned domain, resolving directly where the answer is clear and routing everything else up with contextContribute to audit-ready documentation within your scope, following existing templates and standardsSupport cross-functional GSIS projects of low to moderate complexity, owning specific workstreams within a project rather than the project's overall scope, timeline, or stakeholder communication

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have program management experience in or adjacent to the corporate/physical security domain: you understand what a personal security program looks like, even if you haven't run one independentlyHave contributed to a personal security program or capability build in a high-growth environment, including documentation, playbooks, or training materialsBring working familiarity with at least one or two GSIS domains, with the speed and willingness to build fluency in othersHave supported the development of policies, procedures, or documentation that held up under reviewWrite clearly and can document security concepts for both specialist and non-specialist audiencesAre comfortable executing against a defined scope, and know to escalate when something shifts beyond that scopeCare about Anthropic's mission and the unique security considerations that come with building frontier AI systems

Strong Candidates May Have

Worked at an AI-focused organization, frontier technology company, or similarly high-growth, high-scrutiny environmentSome operational exposure to a GSIS discipline (intelligence analysis, threat assessment, investigations, executive protection, or security operations center work), even if not as the primary ownerSupported an organization through a security audit, compliance exam, or diligence processSupported a security program with a regional or multi-site footprint

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$195,000—$245,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

rows.descriptionText:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries. As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and strong team ethics. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

Shareworks by Morgan Stanley is fulfilling a vision of becoming the global leader in equity-based (stock) incentive and share purchase savings plan management. We specialize in the delivery of complete web-based services for the full lifecycle of equity-based incentive and savings plans. Through our technically advanced Shareworks™ platform, Shareworks by Morgan Stanley is setting the industry's service standard for the administration and execution of all types of equity-based incentives and savings plans.

Department Profile

Executive Financial Services (“EFS”) supports transactions involving restricted or control stock, often involving Rule 144 Affiliates and Corporate Insiders. These transactions include Rule 10b5-1 Trading Plans, sales under Rule 144 or pursuant to prospectus registration, margining, hedging, gifting, money movement or legend removals for restricted stock. EFS conducts due diligence with Issuer counsel prior to the transaction, negotiates and implements 10b5-1 contracts, supports trade execution pursuant to the plan, and facilitates SEC filings, clearing and settlement of restricted trades. An important part of the service provided by EFS includes education and guidance to Financial Advisors (“FAs”), branch management, issuer counsel, corporate clients, Executive and C-Suite level participants, and other key stakeholders on SEC rules, equity plan administration and operational considerations. Our 10b5-1 team is #1 in our industry and seeks to provide affirmative defense solutions for trading plans for top executives and affiliates while delivering trusted, everyday excellence to Morgan Stanley clients.

Position Summary

The Executive Services Specialist will be responsible for the adoption, implementation and ongoing management of 10b5-1 trading plans and other restricted stock transactions for new and established Issuers. This role serves as the face of E*Trade and Shareworks by Morgan Stanley to Executive and C-Suite level customers and requires daily interaction with executive clients, issuer executive teams, advisors and internal partners. The ideal candidate will bring proven experience supporting senior-level executives, a strong client-service orientation, and the ability to deliver white-glove, concierge-level service while meeting privacy, compliance and audit expectations. The Rule 10b5-1 Specialist is required to be licensed: SIE, Series 7 and Series 63.

Responsibilities

 Serve as a primary point of contact for executive-level participants, issuer executive teams, Financial Advisors, Executive Relationship Managers, Trade Desk, Specialist Teams and other cross-functional partners on 10b5-1 plans, restricted stock transactions and related equity plan matters. Provide high-quality, responsive support through inbound and outbound calls and email inquiries, including responding to client questions, supporting plan administration, maintaining accurate EFS records, ensuring appropriate documentation of Rule 10b5-1 trading plans, and resolving or escalating complaints and complex service issues as appropriate. Lead 10b5-1 plan implementation discussions with Executive Relationship Managers, Issuers and clients, advising on plan structuring and trade schedules while considering tax, legal, market, optical and operational considerations. Support complex restricted stock and equity transaction activity, including Rule 144 filings, share gifting, money movement, clearing and settlement, option exercises, restricted stock vests, SARs and related administration. Develop and maintain strong working knowledge of SEC rules, including Rule 10b5-1, Rule 144, Rule 10b-18 and Section 16, and provide educational support to FAs, clients and internal partners. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, strengthen service delivery, reduce risk and scale support for executive clients and issuer relationships. Support Issuer and client prospects, speaking engagements and conferences as needed, including presenting Morgan Stanley’s capabilities and demonstrating understanding of plan administration operations.

Required Qualifications / Skills

 Bachelor’s degree required. Current SIE, Series 7 and Series 63 licenses required. MBA, CFA, Certified Equity Professional (CEP) or Equity Compensation Associate (ECA) designation preferred. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and PowerPoint, required. Prior experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking/Origination, Wealth Management, Executive Services or Stock Plan Administration preferred. Demonstrated success supporting clients in a high-touch service environment, including executive and C-Suite level clients. Strong phone, email, presentation, negotiation and written communication skills. Strong analytical, attention-to-detail, problem-solving and prioritization skills, with the ability to triage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Self-motivated and able to learn independently, exercise sound judgment and work with limited immediate supervision. Positive, professional client-service orientation with enthusiasm for building strong relationships and delivering everyday excellence. Willingness to provide off-hours support during peak business cycles as needed.

Morgan Stanley's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our standards of integrity and excellence. Consequently, our recruiting efforts reflect our desire to attract and retain the best and brightest from all talent pools. We want to be the first choice for prospective employees.

It is the policy of the Firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, transgender, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

New York Only: Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $70,000 to $100,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

rows.title: Market Research Analyst or Senior Analyst, Technology Practice

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

 Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.  Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”  Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.  Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .  Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .  AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.  Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.  Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.  Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.  Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.  Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome! 


 Position Type 

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

 Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York  Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans  401K with company match  Generous paid Parental Leave  Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases  Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities  Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)  Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building  NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program  Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties  Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options 


 Our Commitment 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in all locations within the United States for this role is $62,000 -$7 8 , 0 00. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.



Job Description

NBCUniversal’s Data & Legal Solutions team operates as a central program operations group embedded across Ad Sales, Direct to Consumer, Distribution, Marketing, Research, Technology, Legal, and HR as trusted partners working together to implement strategic programs throughout the enterprise to effectively close gaps between central business and technology groups across a variety of projects.  We work to provide relevant insights & structure across our diverse portfolio to power intelligent business decisions required to compete within today’s extraordinarily complex multi-platform & fragmented media landscape.   

NBCUniversal is seeking a highly motivated Senior Business Analyst – Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) to own and evolve our enterprise contract management platform. This role serves as the primary business lead for CLM capabilities, partnering with Legal, Sourcing, Studios, Privacy, Compliance, and Technology teams to streamline contract processes, drive platform adoption, and deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, compliance, and business outcomes. 

The successful candidate will act as the configuration lead for CLM, translating business needs into scalable workflows, managing vendor relationships, driving roadmap priorities, and helping shape NBCUniversal’s next generation of AI-enabled contract management capabilities. The role supports the continued evolution of enterprise CLM, contract intake modernization, workflow automation, reporting, integrations, and enterprise expansion initiatives. 

Responsibilities:

CLM Platform OwnershipServe as the primary business owner for the CLM platform (Malbek). Manage and prioritize the CLM enhancement backlog and roadmap. Configure workflows, templates, clause libraries, metadata models, approval routing, and reporting capabilities. Partner with application support and vendors to troubleshoot issues and implement enhancements. Identify opportunities to improve contract lifecycle efficiency and user experience. Business Analysis & Solution DeliveryLead requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders across Legal, Procurement, Studios, Media, and Corporate functions. Document business processes, future-state workflows, functional requirements, and solution designs. Conduct fit-gap assessments and make recommendations for process and technology improvements. Support testing, release management, training, and change adoption activities. Enterprise Contract TransformationDrive expansion of CLM capabilities across new business units and use cases. Support intake modernization, workflow standardization, and governance initiatives. Partner with Legal Operations and Technology teams to establish scalable contract management practices. Develop KPIs and reporting to measure adoption, efficiency, and business value. AI & Innovation Evaluate and implement AI-enabled contracting capabilities, including drafting support, clause analysis, contract summarization, semantic search, and metadata automation. Partner with enterprise AI teams and vendors to identify new use cases and productivity opportunities. Support pilot programs and business case development for emerging CLM technologies. Stakeholder ManagementAct as trusted advisor to Legal, Procurement, Operations, Privacy, Records Management, and Compliance stakeholders. Facilitate executive updates, roadmap reviews, and steering committee discussions. Coordinate across product, operations, vendor, and technology teams to ensure successful delivery. 

Qualifications

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Technology, Legal Operations, or related field. 5+ years of business analysis, product ownership, legal operations, contract management, or enterprise application experience. Experience supporting Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms such as Malbek, Icertis, Ironclad, Agiloft, Sirion, Ariba, or similar solutions. Strong experience gathering requirements, designing workflows, and managing stakeholder relationships. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive process transformation. Experience with reporting, data analysis, and process optimization. Desired Characteristics:

Experience supporting Legal, Procurement, Compliance, Records Management, or Sourcing organizations. Familiarity with contract drafting, negotiation, approval workflows, and contract repositories. Experience with AI-enabled productivity tools and automation platforms. Knowledge of integrations, metadata management, and system governance. Agile, product management, or business process improvement certifications are a plus. Success Measures (First 12–18 Months)

Increase CLM adoption across targeted business units. Deliver roadmap priorities supporting workflow automation, intake modernization, and reporting enhancements. Improve contract cycle times and reduce manual touchpoints. Expand AI-enabled contracting capabilities and user adoption. Establish scalable governance, training, and operational processes for enterprise-wide CLM growth. Additional Requirements:

This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $110,000 - $140,000



Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Job Purpose

Fanatics Collectibles is hiring an Associate, People Intelligence to help grow an AI-native people intelligence function. This hands-on, high-impact role sits at the intersection of workforce analytics, data, AI, systems, and process automation, turning people data into decisions and building practical tools and workflows that improve how HR and the business operate.

The ideal candidate pairs strong analytical ability with an AI-native, builder-oriented working style. You should have experience writing SQL; connecting, structuring, and validating data from multiple sources; translating data into a clear story; and using AI to accelerate analytical, technical, and operational work. You will help build internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, dashboards, automations, and repeatable workflows that make people data and People processes easier to use.

You will also design and operate AI-agent workflows, connect AI and automation safely to sensitive people data and enterprise systems, strengthen data, application, and process governance, and partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to simplify, standardize, and automate programs. Success requires the ability to solve ambiguous problems, carry improvements from discovery through implementation, and maintain a team-first mindset. This is a small team with meaningful scope, where you will own work from day one and help shape how the function operates.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain analyses, dashboards, reports, and AI-powered intelligence experiences that answer meaningful workforce questions—including retention, hiring-pipeline health, skills gaps, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, and employee experience—and give HR, Recruiting, Finance, and business leaders self-service access to reliable, actionable insights.Write SQL to connect, structure, and validate people data across source systems, Snowflake, and downstream tools; support governed data models and data lake and data warehouse environments; and resolve data-quality issues at the root cause.Design, build, test, document, and maintain internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, AI-agent and automation workflows, prototypes, and self-service experiences that make people data and processes intuitive, secure, repeatable, and auditable.Partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to map and improve end-to-end programs, reducing manual effort, duplicate entry, unnecessary handoffs, control gaps, and employee or manager friction through automation, standardization, and streamlined design.Create and maintain current- and future-state process and data maps, source-to-target mappings, system and data-flow diagrams, data dictionaries, ownership documentation, standard operating procedures, and related technical documentation.Support data, process, and application governance across sensitive people data, AI-enabled solutions, Oracle HCM, workforce-planning platforms, reporting environments, and automation tools—including access, responsible data handling, lineage, quality controls, ownership, requirements, testing, change control, release documentation, issue management, and auditability.Partner with HR, Employee Lifecycle, Finance, business, and technical stakeholders to translate needs into prioritized improvement opportunities and maintain a transparent roadmap across analytics, systems, applications, automation, and process improvement.

What You Bring

1–3+ years of experience in data, analytics, business systems, HR systems, process improvement, automation, or a related technical or analytical role.Proficiency in SQL, with foundational knowledge of data modeling, data structures, and how information moves across systems.Hands-on experience using AI tools, agents, or AI-assisted workflows—such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms—to complete analytical, technical, or operational work.Experience building or prototyping internal tools, automations, Web App-based experiences, or deliverables using code, low-code/no-code platforms, or AI-assisted development.Experience mapping and documenting processes, data flows, system interactions, requirements, controls, and ownership, with a foundational understanding of data privacy, security, role-based access, quality, and governance.Demonstrated ability to identify issues in data, systems, or workflows; carry improvements from problem definition through testing and implementation; and translate stakeholder needs into workable solutions across technical and non-technical teams.Comfort operating in a fluid, fast-moving environment where processes, tools, and standards are still being built, with strong attention to detail and a habit of validating outputs.Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, Organizational Behavior, Computer Science, or another relevant quantitative, technical, or social science field.

KEY TRAITS WE VALUE

AI-native — uses AI tools to move faster and do more, understands their limitations, and has informed opinions about where AI does and does not add value.Product-minded builder — translates ambiguous business problems into simple, usable tools and workflows, improves them based on feedback, and follows through beyond launch.Systems and governance mindset — understands how data, processes, systems, controls, and decisions connect and moves quickly without sacrificing security, quality, documentation, appropriate access, or process discipline.Technically self-sufficient — can take work from data pull or problem definition through testing, documentation, and clean output, with appropriate support and escalation.Curious about people, not just data — wants to understand what the numbers, systems, and process outcomes mean for employees, managers, and the organization.
