rows.title: Product Specialist, Product Management, Global Consumer Credit Commercialization
rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Product Specialist, Product Management, Global Consumer Credit Commercialization

Overview

Mastercard’s Global Consumer Credit team is responsible for developing and commercializing consumer credit products, value propositions, and related capabilities that help our partners drive portfolio growth, deepen cardholder engagement, and deliver differentiated consumer experiences. The team supports a broad set of global priorities for affluent and non-affluent consumer credit products, including key value propositions such as The Mastercard Collection, and focuses on sales enablement, customer engagement, market insights, and performance tracking.

Role

The Product Specialist will support the execution of global commercialization priorities for consumer credit products. This role will help to create sales enablement materials, support customer engagement efforts, identify actionable insights, assist with marketing strategies, and maintain reporting.

In This Role, You Will

 Support the execution of the global consumer credit commercialization strategy for affluent and non-affluent credit products. Develop, maintain, and refresh sales enablement materials, commercialization toolkits, customer-facing narratives, and internal education materials that help regional teams and account managers with positioning Mastercard consumer credit products effectively. Support critical consumer credit RFPs and strategic customer meetings by coordinating inputs, compiling insights, and helping to create clear and compelling materials in partnership with cross-functional contributors. Help build customer and segment-specific materials that communicate the value of Mastercard consumer credit products, including value proposition articulation, issuer benefits, cardholder benefits, product differentiation, and commercial relevance. Support the development of case studies, proof points, success stories, and examples that demonstrate the value and impact of Mastercard consumer credit products and commercialization initiatives. Track market, issuer, and competitor activity across affluent and non-affluent credit, synthesizing relevant trends and insights into clear summaries that can inform sales enablement, RFP responses, and commercialization recommendations. Maintain commercialization trackers, KPI reporting, pipeline views, and other tools that improve visibility into consumer credit commercialization activity, regional progress, sales enablement needs, and business performance. Extract and analyze performance data, market information, and regional feedback to identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and recommendations that support commercialization execution. Contribute to the development and improvement of repeatable commercialization processes, tools, templates, and knowledge resources that increase consistency, quality, and scalability across global and regional teams. Coordinate operating activity for global consumer credit commercialization, including recurring updates, regional input collection, action tracking, and material refresh updates. Support leadership updates, business reviews, internal communications, and stakeholder materials by synthesizing complex inputs into clear, concise, well-structured outputs. Support ad hoc strategic and executional requests. Partner cross-functionally with global and regional Product, Sales, Marketing, Services, Finance, Legal, regional teams.


About You

 Experience supporting commercialization, sales enablement, strategy, or consulting is preferred. Strong execution mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate inputs across stakeholders, maintain high-quality outputs, and deliver work on time in a fast-moving environment. Strong analytical orientation, with the ability to maintain trackers, synthesize data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, structured, outputs that can be adapted for internal and customer-facing audiences. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to maintain tools, templates, trackers, reporting, content repositories, and governance processes that support consistent execution across teams. Comfortable working across global, regional, and matrixed teams with the ability to build effective working relationships. Proactive, dependable, and comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a willingness to take ownership of defined workstreams, propose solutions, and follow through to completion. Demonstrates curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, commitment to continuous learning, and the ability to bring structure and clarity to complex business topics.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Pay Ranges

Thank you for considering Progyny!

As a Client Success Associate, you will support the efficient management of a large portfolio of clients in a lower-touch service model. In this role, you will work collaboratively with peers and cross-functional partners to ensure client needs are addressed accurately, consistently, and in a timely manner. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable balancing multiple client requests while maintaining a strong service experience.

The Client Success Associate will play an important role in supporting day-to-day client administration, monitoring client needs, coordinating issue resolution, and ensuring clients receive reliable support across routine interactions. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, sound judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do...

Manage day-to-day requests across a large book of business, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional follow-up. Work collaboratively with Client Success peers to support a scalable, consistent client experience across a lower-touch portfolio. Triage client inquiries, determine appropriate next steps, and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues efficiently. Track client requests, open items, and escalations to ensure follow-through and clear communication. Maintain accurate client records, documentation, and activity tracking within client management tools. Support routine client reporting, client health checks, and administrative updates as needed. Identify recurring client questions, process gaps, or service trends and share insights with the broader team. Partner with Sales, Product, Operations, Member Services, and other internal teams to support client needs and resolution timelines. Communicate clearly and professionally with clients, ensuring they feel supported even within a lower-touch engagement model. Balance competing priorities across multiple clients while maintaining strong attention to detail and service quality. 

About You...

Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience in a client-facing, customer support, operations, or business-related role. Strong responsiveness and follow-through, with a commitment to timely and high-quality client service. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage a large volume of requests across multiple clients. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities and evolving needs. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to be clear, concise, and professional. Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with peers and cross-functional partners. Sound judgment and problem-solving skills, including knowing when to escalate issues appropriately. Proficiency or willingness to learn CRM software, client management tools, and internal reporting systems. Operational mindset with a focus on efficiency, consistency, and process improvement. Positive, service-oriented attitude and willingness to contribute to a team-based client support model.

rows.descriptionText:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

 Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.  Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”  Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.  Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .  Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .  AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.  Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.  Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.  Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.  Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.  Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome! 


 Position Type 

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

 Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York  Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans  401K with company match  Generous paid Parental Leave  Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases  Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities  Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)  Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building  NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program  Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties  Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options 


 Our Commitment 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in all locations within the United States for this role is $62,000 -$7 8 , 0 00. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

rows.descriptionText:
Description

WHO WE ARE

Mojo Supermarket is a fully integrated agency built on the creative philosophy "Break your Brain Good." We create work that rewires the way people think and helps brands solve their biggest business challenges. By combining strategic thinking with bold creative, we deliver ideas that generate outsized business results for clients including TikTok, Burger King, Chase, DoorDash, Ruggable, and more.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Analyst, Data & Analytics who is curious about what data can tell us about people, brands and the work we make — and who knows that the job doesn’t stop at reporting the numbers.

You’ll work across campaign, social, platform and audience data to understand what’s happening, dig into why it’s happening and help turn those findings into clear stories and recommendations for our Strategy, Creative, Account and Social teams.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of room to grow. You’ll build analyses and reporting, work directly with teams and clients, and help us continue developing how Data & Analytics shows up across the agency.

We don’t expect you to arrive having done everything on this job description. We care most about strong analytical instincts, curiosity, clear communication and the ability to learn quickly. If you have a solid foundation in marketing analytics and want to broaden into areas like social intelligence, creator measurement, audience insights and creative effectiveness, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Pull, organize and analyze data across campaigns, platforms, audiences, social/content and other relevant sources.  Build reports, dashboards and analyses that make complicated information easy to understand and useful.  Look beyond what happened to investigate why it happened, what it means and what we should do next.  Identify trends, anomalies, audience behaviors, performance gaps and opportunities.  Turn findings into clear insights and recommendations for Strategy, Creative, Account, Social and clients.  Partner closely with Strategy and Creative to connect data to briefs, ideas, content, testing and future decisions.  Help teams understand how work is performing — and where the data may challenge an assumption or point toward a better question.  Contribute to client conversations and grow your ability to present and defend analytical findings.  Help develop measurement approaches for accounts and campaigns alongside Strategy leadership.  Work with and continue building fluency across areas such as social/content analytics, social listening, audience intelligence and creator measurement.  Maintain accuracy and consistency across reporting and data sources. 

Requirements

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

2+ years of experience in analytics, marketing analytics, media analytics, measurement, research, insights or a related discipline.  Hands-on experience working with quantitative marketing or audience data.  Strong analytical instincts and a desire to understand the story behind the numbers.  The ability to move from data → insight → recommendation, not simply report performance.  Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can explain complicated information in plain English.  Experience in at least one relevant area such as campaign analytics, paid social/digital analytics, audience analysis, social/content analytics or marketing measurement.  Comfort working with data in tools such as Excel/Sheets, dashboards, analytics platforms or comparable environments.  Curiosity about brands, advertising, social media, culture and creative work.  A collaborative mindset and an interest in working closely with Creative, Strategy, Account and Social.  Enough confidence to form a point of view — and enough curiosity to change it when the data tells you something new.  A willingness to learn capabilities you may not have worked with yet.

NICE TO HAVE

Agency or client-facing marketing experience.  Experience presenting findings or recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders.  Experience with social listening, audience-intelligence or creator-measurement platforms.  Familiarity with tools such as Meltwater, GWI, Tubular, Brandwatch, Sprinklr or comparable platforms.  Dashboard-building experience.  SQL, Python or other analytical/automation skills.  Experience analyzing creative or content performance.

What Success Looks Like

You produce reliable analysis, but you’re also developing a reputation for finding the interesting thing in the data.You ask good questions, spot patterns other people may miss and can explain why a finding matters without burying the team in numbers.Strategy, Creative, Account and Social teams trust you as a thought partner, not simply the person who produces the report.Over time, you expand your fluency across social, audience, creator and measurement disciplines and take on increasingly complex analytical questions.Most importantly, your work helps Mojo make better-informed creative, strategic and business decisions.

WORKING MODEL

Mojo operates on a hybrid working model, with our team together in our New York City office Tuesday through Thursday.

Benefits

Competitive salary401(k) with up to a 4% company matchMedical, dental, and vision insuranceFlexible paid time off Paid parental leave Culture & wellness StipendFive-week paid sabbatical for employees with five years of serviceTwice monthly team mealsPre-tax commuter benefits

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

 Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.  Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”  Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.  Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .  Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .  AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.  Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.  Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.  Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.  Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.  Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome! 


 Position Type 

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

 Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York  Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans  401K with company match  Generous paid Parental Leave  Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases  Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities  Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)  Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building  NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program  Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties  Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options 


 Our Commitment 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. Compensation

This hands-on, high-impact role sits at the intersection of workforce analytics, data, AI, systems, and process automation, turning people data into decisions and building practical tools and workflows that improve how HR and the business operate.

You should have experience writing SQL; connecting, structuring, and validating data from multiple sources; translating data into a clear story; and using AI to accelerate analytical, technical, and operational work. You will help build internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, dashboards, automations, and repeatable workflows that make people data and People processes easier to use.

You will also design and operate AI-agent workflows, connect AI and automation safely to sensitive people data and enterprise systems, strengthen data, application, and process governance, and partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to simplify, standardize, and automate programs. Success requires the ability to solve ambiguous problems, carry improvements from discovery through implementation, and maintain a team-first mindset. This is a small team with meaningful scope, where you will own work from day one and help shape how the function operates.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain analyses, dashboards, reports, and AI-powered intelligence experiences that answer meaningful workforce questions—including retention, hiring-pipeline health, skills gaps, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, and employee experience—and give HR, Recruiting, Finance, and business leaders self-service access to reliable, actionable insights.Write SQL to connect, structure, and validate people data across source systems, Snowflake, and downstream tools; support governed data models and data lake and data warehouse environments; and resolve data-quality issues at the root cause.Design, build, test, document, and maintain internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, AI-agent and automation workflows, prototypes, and self-service experiences that make people data and processes intuitive, secure, repeatable, and auditable.Partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to map and improve end-to-end programs, reducing manual effort, duplicate entry, unnecessary handoffs, control gaps, and employee or manager friction through automation, standardization, and streamlined design.Create and maintain current- and future-state process and data maps, source-to-target mappings, system and data-flow diagrams, data dictionaries, ownership documentation, standard operating procedures, and related technical documentation.Support data, process, and application governance across sensitive people data, AI-enabled solutions, Oracle HCM, workforce-planning platforms, reporting environments, and automation tools—including access, responsible data handling, lineage, quality controls, ownership, requirements, testing, change control, release documentation, issue management, and auditability.Partner with HR, Employee Lifecycle, Finance, business, and technical stakeholders to translate needs into prioritized improvement opportunities and maintain a transparent roadmap across analytics, systems, applications, automation, and process improvement.

What You Bring

1–3+ years of experience in data, analytics, business systems, HR systems, process improvement, automation, or a related technical or analytical role.Proficiency in SQL, with foundational knowledge of data modeling, data structures, and how information moves across systems.Hands-on experience using AI tools, agents, or AI-assisted workflows—such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms—to complete analytical, technical, or operational work.Experience building or prototyping internal tools, automations, Web App-based experiences, or deliverables using code, low-code/no-code platforms, or AI-assisted development.Experience mapping and documenting processes, data flows, system interactions, requirements, controls, and ownership, with a foundational understanding of data privacy, security, role-based access, quality, and governance.Demonstrated ability to identify issues in data, systems, or workflows; carry improvements from problem definition through testing and implementation; and translate stakeholder needs into workable solutions across technical and non-technical teams.Comfort operating in a fluid, fast-moving environment where processes, tools, and standards are still being built, with strong attention to detail and a habit of validating outputs.Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, Organizational Behavior, Computer Science, or another relevant quantitative, technical, or social science field.

KEY TRAITS WE VALUE

AI-native — uses AI tools to move faster and do more, understands their limitations, and has informed opinions about where AI does and does not add value.Product-minded builder — translates ambiguous business problems into simple, usable tools and workflows, improves them based on feedback, and follows through beyond launch.Systems and governance mindset — understands how data, processes, systems, controls, and decisions connect and moves quickly without sacrificing security, quality, documentation, appropriate access, or process discipline.Technically self-sufficient — can take work from data pull or problem definition through testing, documentation, and clean output, with appropriate support and escalation.Curious about people, not just data — wants to understand what the numbers, systems, and process outcomes mean for employees, managers, and the organization.

About This Role

Orchestra is looking for an Analytics Specialist to play a key role in the growth and evolution of our Strategic Insights team. We want someone energized by the opportunity to deliver thoughtful, high-impact analyses that help our clients make data-driven decisions.

This person should bring a strong foundation in analytics tools and a passion for creating compelling reports that support the agency’s insights deliverables. Above all, this person will be intellectually curious, motivated, and excited by the possibilities of what can be measured, learned, and achieved through data.

Accountabilities & Qualifications

Experience supporting integrated marketing, communications or digital campaigns in an agency, consultancy or in-house environmentExperience leveraging media monitoring and social listening tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Brandwatch, Meltwater)Experience with audience intelligence tools (e.g., GWI, MRI Simmons, Stat Social, YouGov, Statista)Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau and LookerCuriosity and engagement when analyzing complex or technical datasetsStrong digital storytelling abilities

rows.title: Market Research Analyst or Senior Analyst, Technology Practice

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

 Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.  Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”  Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.  Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .  Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .  AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.  Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.  Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.  Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.  Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.  Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome! 


 Position Type 

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

 Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York  Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans  401K with company match  Generous paid Parental Leave  Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases  Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities  Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)  Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building  NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program  Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties  Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options 


 Our Commitment 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in all locations within the United States for this role is $62,000 -$7 8 , 0 00. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

rows.title: Jr. Brand Marketing Analyst – onsite freelance

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our client, a global entertainment network is seeking a Marketing Analyst. This is a 12 month contract (40 hours a week) that is onsite 4 days a week in Los Angeles or New York.

The Growth Marketing team is seeking a Marketing Planning Analyst who will join our New York City or Los Angeles Marketing Planning and Analysis team and collaborate closely with Analytics, Finance, and Paid Media teams to deliver planning, execution, and optimization of paid media marketing plans across domestic and international territories. Candidates will need to distill business trends and performance indicators into decisions that drive marketing investment.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in digital performance marketing channels and knows about respective levers to pull back or push performance.

The successful candidate will bring a highly analytical, cross-channel, and seasoned planning skillset to the role.

Responsibilities

Lead paid media planning and forecasting across channels, including Affiliate, Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic Display, Audio, and Video

Build and manage bottoms-up budgets, country-level goals, pacing, and performance forecasts

Synthesize cross-channel performance data to inform strategy, highlight insights, and guide investment decisions

Develop business cases and scenario modeling to evaluate impact of growth initiatives and trade-offs

Create and deliver executive-ready reporting, including performance reviews with global and regional leads

Partner with global channel owners on planning, optimization, and best practices

Collaborate with regional market teams on local nuances (holidays, platforms, consumer behavior)

Support implementation and execution of marketing mix model results

Support channel and vendor-level tracking, monitoring, and reporting of marketing KPIs (conversion rates, CPA, retention, LTV, etc.) to help guide ongoing marketing tactics for the team

Act as key point of contact within Growth Marketing for any questions regarding paid media planning and spend pacing for assigned region(s)

Basic Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Business, or related field

2+ years experience in performance marketing, digital media planning, DTC or subscription-based business

Strong analytical, financial modeling, and forecasting skills (SQL, R a plus)

Proficiency in data visualization (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), Google Suite and advanced Excel

Excellent communication skills with ability to distill complex data for executive audiences

Strong project management skills; able to manage shifting priorities and deliver high-quality work quickly.

Experience with campaign management and optimization across major media platforms

rows.title: Market Research Analyst or Senior Analyst, Technology Practice

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

 Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.  Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”  Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.  Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .  Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .  AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.  Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.  Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.  Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.  Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.  Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome! 


 Position Type 

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

 Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York  Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans  401K with company match  Generous paid Parental Leave  Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases  Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities  Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)  Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building  NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program  Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties  Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options 


 Our Commitment 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in all locations within the United States for this role is $62,000 -$7 8 , 0 00. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

This role is for a 2027 start date.

At IBM, we believe technology shapes the world, and we are a catalyst for innovation and creativity. We are at the forefront of groundbreaking change — improving businesses, society, and the human condition. As a leader in Hybrid Cloud and AI, we are leading the charge in a worldwide digital transformation. 

Our Performance Marketing team drives scalable and predictable revenue growth. We exist to generate demand for IBM’s products and offerings — and to convert that demand into measurable pipeline and business impact. As part of our team, you'll be surrounded by bright minds and keen collaborators — always willing to help and be helped — as you apply passion to work that will compel our audience to choose IBM's products and services.

When you join IBM, you join a culture of openness, collaboration, and trust. You join a team of IBMers who are helping technology support a positive global transformation. So join us and experience a place where you can co-create your learning and opportunities. A place where teamwork and unique ideas are treasured. A place where you can bring innovation to life. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an IBM Marketing Analytics Intern, you’ll work collaboratively, driving work that addresses a strategic IBM Marketing business challenge.  You will have the opportunity to focus on uncovering, synthesizing, and applying analytic insights that drive both strategic and tactical outcomes for the company and directly guide marketing execution.

In addition to your project work, the internship includes educational, networking, and social activities. At the end of program, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your final outcomes to a large audience of leaders, practitioners, and peers across the organization. This is a highly visible intern program with leadership exposure and mentorship throughout the summer.

Responsibilities

This internship would support our Marketing Analytics team. This team is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing our paid media, marketing automation, and performance intelligence activities to deliver value to our business. As an intern on this team, you could be involved in helping answer analytics questions and helping to further business objectives in one or more of these areas:

Optimizingpaidmediacampaignsand tacticsto increase relevance of the IBM brand and drive demand for priority productsAnalyzing, designing,and enhancingomni-channel audience journeysto serve our prospective clients relevant and personalized content in the right place at the right timeDrivinginnovation at the intersection of marketing and AI, through generative AI for content creation, process automation forenhancedproductivity, and more

This role is based in New York City. We work in a hybrid environment. This position will be required to come into the office at least three days per week.

This role will be posted until September 18. We will review all applications.

IBM will not be providing Visa sponsorship for these positions now or in the future. Therefore, to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future Visa sponsorship. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 (including those with OPT or CPT), H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Currently enrolled in an accredited UniversityCompleting anundergraddegree program between Winter 2026 and Summer 2027Passionate about marketing, data,analytics,or a related fieldFluent in English; strong written and verbal communication skillsProblem-solving and analytical skillsA strategic, consultative, data-driven mindsetSQL, Excel, Python, R for data analysis

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Basic knowledge of marketing, communications, data analytics, or related areaBasic market research skillsBasic knowledge of how toleveragedata to tell a storyTableau, Excel,PowerBI, Cognos for data visualization

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Harlem Grown is an independent, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization whose mission is to inspire youth to lead healthy and ambitious lives through mentorship and hands-on education in urban farming, sustainability and nutrition. We operate local urban farms, increase access to and knowledge of healthy food for Harlem residents, and provide farm-based development programs to Harlem youth.

Founded in 2011 by Tony Hillery with one school partnership, one urban farm and an idea to help Harlem children, today Harlem Grown's farms and greenhouses are used as classrooms and as venues to cultivate a connection to the environment and food among young people. Harlem Grown operates 14 urban agricultural sites featuring soil-based urban farms, hydroponic greenhouses, and a mushroom chamber. All of our sites are located between 122nd and 152nd Streets in Central Harlem, Manhattan.

Our Programs

Harlem Grown cultivates deep community roots by growing fresh food, strong youth, and lasting relationships. We meet children where they live, learn, and grow—offering opportunities that extend beyond our farms to the classroom and into their futures. Through Food and Farm Education, we help youth build healthy habits, leadership skills, and a deeper connection to their community. Our urban farms provide free produce and nutritious meals for families while creating joyful spaces for connection and support. Through 14 urban farms and year-round programming, we provide free produce, nutritious meals, and cooking lessons while creating joyful spaces for connection and support. In addition, our programs increase economic opportunity for families and develop leadership and advocacy skills so participants can drive transformational change in their communities.

At Harlem Grown, we grow healthy children and communities through hands-on education, access to resources, and long-term youth support. Our Food and Farm Education —including summer camp, in-school and after-school programs, mobile education, service learning, and farm tours—delivers farm-based lessons to children in our community. We offer free community resources like farmstands, Saturdays on the farm, and events that provide fresh food and create spaces for support and connection. Through academic support, internships, and career readiness programs, we help our young people build confidence and skills to thrive from elementary school through adulthood.

Role Overview

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Finance & Operations Analyst supports Harlem Grown's financial resiliency and operational effectiveness through contract administration, accounts payable and receivable, financial reconciliation, budget management, compliance, and other nonprofit finance functions.

This is a new role designed to support the growing complexity of Harlem Grown's financial operations, particularly as the organization expands its government contracts and paid partnerships.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail oriented, and compliance focused, with experience in nonprofit finance or operations. This individual should be comfortable managing multiple workflows simultaneously, coordinating across departments, and maintaining accurate financial and operational records.

Key Responsibilities

Contracts & Partnerships | 25%

Government Contracts

Manage and coordinate government contract operations from award through reimbursement, including:

Document and maintain processes, timelines, and project templates for awarding entities and agencies at the local, state, and federal levels. Coordinate across departments to compile contract and reporting requirements, including impact data, budgets, scopes of work, payroll documentation, insurance certificates, and other required materials. Maintain a detailed tracking system for past, current, and upcoming government awards. Serve as administrator for Harlem Grown's accounts across government contracting and reporting portals, including NYS SFS, MOCS PASSPort, DYCD Connect, and other applicable systems. Proactively follow up with agency representatives to support timely contracting, invoicing, reimbursement, and payment. Ensure compliance with applicable government regulations and funder requirements related to financial practices, documentation, and recordkeeping. 

Paid Partnerships

Collaborate with the Manager of Partnerships and Events to manage accounts payable and financial processes related to Harlem Grown's fee for service programming. Generate recurring and ad hoc invoices for paid partnerships. Maintain an up to date database of contracts, terms, deadlines, and organizational obligations. Track contract renewal dates to ensure agreements are reviewed, renegotiated, renewed, or canceled as appropriate before expiration. 

Accounts Payable & Receivable | 25%

Deposit checks and communicate donation and invoice payments to appropriate internal stakeholders. Issue invoices for contracts, partnerships, and ad hoc requests. Review weekly Accounts Receivable Aging reports to identify overdue balances, outstanding partner payments, and payments not yet reflected in financial systems. Serve as a point of contact for staff regarding expense coding, reimbursements, payables, and payment status. Review invoices and employee reimbursements for accuracy, appropriate coding, supporting documentation, and compliance with financial procedures. Facilitate payable and reimbursement approval workflows and process payments once required approvals are complete. Maintain Harlem Grown's corporate card and expense management systems, ensuring complete and accurate data entry and adherence to financial policies and procedures. 

Monthly Financial Close | 15%

Coordinate organizational credit card activity, including receipt collection, expense documentation, and coding. Compile expense reports from third party platforms, including Amazon, Uber, and other vendors, for review by the accounting team. Support reconciliation between QuickBooks Online, Salesforce, and other applicable financial records. Identify discrepancies and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders to resolve outstanding documentation or coding issues. 

Net Asset Reconciliation | 10%

Ensure accurate transaction level coding of restricted net assets at least quarterly. Provide complete financial reports to the Advancement Team no later than one month before applicable grant reporting deadlines. Monitor restricted funding against approved budgets and proactively flag potential overfunded budget lines. Coordinate with Advancement when donor modifications or budget reallocations may be required. 

Budgeting & Financial Reporting | 10%

Support the annual organizational budgeting process and ad hoc financial reporting requests. Maintain department level budget trackers and respond to questions from department budget owners. Develop budgets as needed for programs, projects, grant applications, government contracts, and paid partnerships. Support financial analysis and reporting to help teams understand spending against approved budgets. 

General Operations & Compliance | 10%

Serve as a cross functional partner to the Program, Operations, and Advancement teams on major compliance projects and multi department initiatives. Support projects including program license renewals, bids and proposals, process documentation, purchasing and procurement, grant applications, and grant reporting. Maintain compliance with accounting best practices, internal controls, organizational procedures, and financial systems. Identify opportunities to strengthen documentation, workflows, and internal financial processes. Complete special projects and research assignments as needed. Perform other duties as assigned. 

Audit & Tax Filing Support | 5%

Support the annual financial audit and tax filing process. Compile financial records, supporting documentation, and requested materials for Harlem Grown's internal finance team, accountants, and auditors. Provide supporting context and documentation to help resolve audit questions and requests. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree and at least 1 to 2 years of professional experience in nonprofit finance, accounting, administration, operations, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including experience with financial analysis and modeling. Working knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls, and accounting best practices. Experience working with accounting software, financial management systems, and/or CRM platforms. Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple deadlines, workflows, and priorities simultaneously. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and communicate financial information to nonfinance colleagues. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with QuickBooks Online and Salesforce. Experience supporting nonprofit financial operations, government contracts, grants, or restricted funding. Understanding of restricted net asset management and grant related financial reporting. Familiarity with youth development, education, or community based nonprofit programming. Experience working with government contracting and vendor systems, including New York State Financial System (SFS), MOCS PASSPort, NYC Public Schools vendor systems, and DYCD Connect. Experience coordinating financial or compliance requirements across multiple departments. 

Compensation Range

$70,000—$75,000 USD

At Harlem Grown, diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. We are an equal opportunity employer, and are committed to creating a culture of inclusivity, where each individual feels as if their identity, experience, and values are represented and supported. We are dedicated to creating a space where children, especially those of color, are given the opportunity and skills to lead healthy and ambitious lives. We strongly believe in building a team that reflects and appreciates the underrepresented population of students, families, and people that we serve. Become a member of our family.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
We are looking for dedicated and motivated active-duty military veterans to join our team for a Military SkillBridge Internship. This role offers a unique opportunity to leverage your leadership, problem-solving, and analytical skills gained through military service in the fast-paced world of Commercial banking and Credit Analysis. This position is right for you if you have 3-5 years of active duty military leadership experience with a strong preference for combat arms and a passion to start a career in finance and commercial banking.

We offer a full time Military SkillBridge Internship to take you from military service to the finance industry. Our program identifies veterans who have a desire to cut their chops in finance, arms them with an industry-leading financial modeling certification, and places them in finance roles with screened and qualified firms looking for transitioned veterans.

Our certified financial modeling program gives you the skills expected of those entering the financial world on day 1:

Model the three financial statements; Format and color code cells to industry standard; Increase your operating speed in Excel

After passing the financial modeling certification, you will start an internship with a leading reginal commercial bank as a Credit Analyst in training. A commercial banking credit analyst's role involves analyzing financial data, assessing risk, assigning credit scores, preparing reports, and communicating findings to make informed lending decisions that balance the bank's profitability and risk exposure.

Key Responsibilities Of a Credit Analyst

Financial Analysis: Credit analysts evaluate the financial health of businesses by analyzing their financial statements, cash flow, and other relevant data. They assess factors like revenue trends, profit margins, debt levels, and liquidity to determine the borrower's ability to repay loans.Risk Assessment: These analysts assess the risk associated with lending to a particular borrower. They consider industry trends, market conditions, and the borrower's credit history to determine the likelihood of repayment. By identifying potential risks, they help the bank make informed lending decisions.Credit Scoring: Credit analysts use various scoring models to quantify the creditworthiness of applicants. They assign credit scores based on factors such as payment history, credit utilization, and length of credit history. These scores assist in standardizing the evaluation process.Report Preparation: Credit analysts compile their findings into detailed reports that outline their assessment of the applicant's creditworthiness. These reports often include financial ratios, risk analysis, and recommendations for loan terms or credit limits. These reports help senior decision-makers in the bank approve or decline loan applications.Communication: Effective communication is crucial in this role. Credit analysts interact with borrowers to gather additional information, clarify financial details, and discuss potential concerns. They also collaborate with colleagues, such as loan officers and underwriters, to ensure a comprehensive evaluation of each application.

The Ideal Candidate Profile Looks Like

 This position is right for you if you have 3-5 years of active duty military leadership experience (preference for combat arms, but not required) and a passion to start a career in finance and commercial banking. Honorable service and exemplary service evaluations Desire for leadership opportunities in the finance world after you prove your ability to "run through walls" in the short term Willing to virtually attend a no-cost financial modeling certification program and test prior to transition.

**To schedule an intake call with Chamberlain's Veterans' Programs department, simply submit your resume and our team will follow up with you**
