Analyst

Department: Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO)

Location: New York, NY

Reports To: Change Management Governance Director

Role Summary

The EPMO Analyst supports the day-to-day operations of the Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) through governance execution, operational administration, tool support, compliance monitoring, and continuous improvement activities. The role partners with project teams, portfolio offices, and governance stakeholders to promote adherence to enterprise standards, policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations.

The Analyst performs quality assurance and quality control reviews, maintains governance records and reports, administers EPMO tools and workflows, supports stakeholder inquiries and requests, and contributes to process improvements that enhance the effectiveness, consistency, and transparency of EPMO operations.

Operations & Administration

Key Responsibilities

 Execute governance activities in accordance with established frameworks, procedures, and controls. Support governance inquiries, submissions, approvals, waivers, and exceptions, including documentation validation, status tracking, and record maintenance. Perform quality assurance (QA) and quality control (QC) reviews to assess completeness, accuracy, compliance with enterprise standards, and readiness for review and approval. Maintain governance procedures, job aids, guidance materials, FAQs, trackers, stakeholder-facing documentation, administration procedures, operational runbooks, and support documentation. Prepare and distribute governance reports, metrics, dashboards, and management information, including data quality reviews and reconciliation activities to support governance and portfolio oversight. Administer EPMO portfolio management and governance platforms, including Planview, PPP, ServiceNow, workflow routing, form maintenance, data updates, user support, and issue triage. Manage governance-related requests, ticket queues, user access, and routine platform administration activities. Coordinate and support configuration changes, system updates, testing, enhancement requests, and defect remediation activities. Identify opportunities to improve governance effectiveness, tool adoption, operational efficiency, user experience, and data integrity across EPMO platforms.

Execution & Stakeholder Support

Key Responsibilities

 Support execution of Enterprise Change Management governance processes and standards for assigned portfolios and initiatives. Provide guidance to project teams and stakeholders on established governance requirements, procedures, and documentation expectations. Coordinate recurring communications between EPMO and Line of Business portfolio offices to support alignment and consistency. Maintain effective working relationships with project managers, risk partners, and business stakeholders. Identify and promptly escalate governance concerns, risks, issues, and exceptions to management. Support project teams in navigating governance processes, required artifacts, approvals, and stage-gate requirements. Assist with tracking governance decisions, actions, issues, risks, and commitments through resolution.

Continuous Improvement

Key Responsibilities

 Identify opportunities to streamline governance processes and improve stakeholder experience. Support testing, documentation, and implementation of process improvements, automation initiatives, and governance tool enhancements. Participate in lessons learned reviews, root cause discussions, and governance maturity initiatives. Analyze governance metrics, stakeholder feedback, and adoption trends to support continuous improvement recommendations. Contribute analysis and recommendations that improve efficiency, transparency, and effectiveness across governance operations. Leverage approved AI and automation capabilities to enhance reporting, data analysis, content development, workflow efficiency, and stakeholder support. Identify, recommend, and support implementation of AI-enabled solutions, automation opportunities, and process standardization initiatives that improve governance operations and user experience.

What This Role Isn't

This isn't a role where you're expected to have all the answers on day one. We're looking for someone who is curious, analytical, eager to learn, and comfortable navigating new challenges.

You don't need to be an AI expert to succeed in this position. An interest in technology and continuous improvement is more important than deep technical expertise.

While reporting, coordination, and governance activities are part of the role, this position goes beyond project administration. You'll have opportunities to solve problems, contribute ideas, influence outcomes, and support meaningful change across the organization.

This role is not limited to maintaining existing processes. You'll help improve how change management, project governance, reporting, and emerging technologies, including AI, are adopted across the enterprise.

Qualifications

Education

 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Risk Management, Project Management, Organizational Development, Organizational Change Management, Information Systems, Technology Management, or a related discipline preferred. Relevant professional certifications or coursework in project management, change management, business analysis, risk management, process improvement, or technology administration are a plus.

Experience

 2-4 years of experience in governance, project coordination, operational risk, compliance, portfolio management, enterprise change management, business operations, tool administration, or a related discipline. Experience supporting governance, portfolio management, regulatory, or enterprise change management activities within a large or highly regulated organization is preferred. Experience supporting platform administration, reporting, workflow management, ticket management, or business process operations is preferred. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

Knowledge & Skills

 Working knowledge of enterprise change management, project governance, portfolio management, or risk and control frameworks. Understanding of workflow-driven applications and governance tools, such as Planview, ServiceNow, SharePoint, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong written, verbal, presentation, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information, identify gaps, and document findings. Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and organizational levels. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams, and Power BI. Experience supporting system testing, configuration changes, reporting, data management, or process administration is preferred. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to quality. Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot and other approved enterprise productivity technologies. Ability to utilize AI-enabled tools to support reporting, analysis, content development, meeting preparation, and operational efficiency. Understanding of responsible AI practices, information security requirements, data privacy standards, and appropriate handling of confidential information. Ability to identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimization, and AI-enabled process improvements. Experience using AI-assisted tools to enhance productivity, data analysis, stakeholder support, and business process execution is preferred.

Job Description:

This job is responsible for conducting quantitative analysis for counterparty credit risk (CCR) that arise in the Global Markets business. The role will support management of various counterparty limit frameworks (Stress Gap, Wrong Way Risk, Contingent Market Risk), monitoring secondary risk factors, point of weakness analysis of the CCR portfolios, and generating management reporting to internal stakeholders, governance and regulators.

Manage counterparty stress-based concentration limit frameworks across asset classes, product types and industry sectors. Perform BAU CCR stress testing including scenario design, implementation and analyzing results to explain key drivers of risk exposures.Partner with the Credit Officers, Enterprise Credit Risk, FLU Sales & Trading on CCR limit calibration and new trade approvals to support the underwriting process. Lead sector specific CCR portfolio reviews along with specialized deep dives on individual counterparties.Develop and maintain risk analytics, secondary Points of Weakness measures to adequately support products and risks to client strategies, develop supplementary risk analysis based on material Risk ID. Collaborate with Market Risk coverage to apply consistent risk approach.Represent CCR in regulatory exams and ongoing monitoring, addressing regulatory findings, and presenting on special topics. Responsibilities
USDS Financial Crime Compliance is responsible for overseeing and operationalizing all aspects related to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Sanctions Compliance activities related to TikTok USDS's operations. Collaborating cross-functionally with stakeholders across the U.S. and globally, we address complex and cutting-edge challenges, which include the identification of money-laundering, terrorist financing and sanction violations. Responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and optimize machine learning models to detect money laundering, fraud, and other financial crimes, leveraging techniques such as anomaly detection, clustering, and predictive modeling.

- Design and implement data visualization dashboards and reporting tools to communicate insights and findings from financial crime detection efforts.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and operations to integrate machine learning solutions into existing systems and processes.
- Perform special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.

About The Role

PURE Insurance is seeking a highly analytical and business-minded Analyst, Broker Channel Optimization to support the growth and effectiveness of our broker distribution channel.

This role will partner closely with Distribution, Field Sales Leadership, Underwriting, and Analytics teams to identify growth opportunities, optimize broker engagement strategies, and provide actionable insights that improve business performance.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving business problems with data, can translate insights into recommendations, and is passionate about helping sales organizations operate more effectively. This role will report to the Director of Broker Strategy and Experience and play a key role in supporting PURE's distribution strategy and growth objectives.

What You'll Do

Analyze broker, office, territory, and producer performance to identify growth opportunities and areas for improvement.Support broker channel optimization initiatives by evaluating market opportunities, broker engagement, and distribution footprint.Build and maintain reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and business insights that help leaders make informed decisions.Conduct broker portfolio analysis to identify opportunities for increased growth, engagement, and share of wallet.Partner with field sales leaders to monitor pipeline health, conversion trends, and business development activity.Support broker segmentation efforts and help evaluate differentiated growth strategies across broker populations.Measure the effectiveness of distribution initiatives, programs, and strategic investments.Develop analytical recommendations that help improve sales productivity and broker performance.Collaborate with technology, analytics, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting capabilities, and self-service insights.Prepare presentations and executive-ready materials that communicate findings, trends, and recommendations.Perform ad hoc analyses to answer business questions and support strategic decision-making.Document metrics, methodologies, and reporting standards to ensure consistency and transparency.


What You'll Need

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.1+ years of professional experience in data analytics, business analytics, insurance, financial services, or a related field.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.Experience using Excel and data visualization tools to analyze and present information.Familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Hex, or similar reporting and analytics tools.Ability to synthesize large amounts of data into clear business insights and recommendations.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively across teams.Curiosity, initiative, and a desire to understand how distribution and sales organizations drive growth.Experience in insurance, financial services, sales analytics, or distribution strategy is a plus.


What Success Looks Like

After the first year, this individual will:

Help the organization identify where growth opportunities exist across the broker channel.Provide insights that improve the effectiveness of broker engagement and sales strategies.Deliver reporting and analytics that allow leaders to make faster, better decisions.Support channel optimization efforts that strengthen PURE's position within key broker relationships.Become a trusted resource for understanding broker performance, distribution trends, and business opportunities.


‌

What We Do

We're a member-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices.

We aim for our members to love their insurance. It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that our members never want to leave.

Who We Are

We want to be transparent about what we expect from each other. From PURE, you can expect:

Opportunities to stretch and grow: your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on-the-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards.

Clarity and kindness: you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like.

Support in good times and bad: we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. You can expect a thoughtful partner, even when we disagree.

A community that cares: we are committed to sustaining a community in which each person feels cared for as an individual. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life.

Who You Are

All of the strongest relationships are a partnership- a two way street. So here’s what we ask of you:

Aim to bring your best every day: you’re here because you want to be part of a team that makes a real impact and aims high.Be a student and a teacher: share your knowledge and talents and be willing to listen and learn from those around you.Get comfortable being uncomfortable: we face tough moments and obstacles with a “courage over comfort” approach and a positive, solutions-oriented mindset.Be a culture builder: building a positive culture is everyone's responsibility, based on care, respect and openness to diverse perspectives.

Description

WHO WE ARE

Mojo Supermarket is a fully integrated agency built on the creative philosophy "Break your Brain Good." We create work that rewires the way people think and helps brands solve their biggest business challenges. By combining strategic thinking with bold creative, we deliver ideas that generate outsized business results for clients including TikTok, Burger King, Chase, DoorDash, Ruggable, and more.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Analyst, Data & Analytics who is curious about what data can tell us about people, brands and the work we make — and who knows that the job doesn’t stop at reporting the numbers.

You’ll work across campaign, social, platform and audience data to understand what’s happening, dig into why it’s happening and help turn those findings into clear stories and recommendations for our Strategy, Creative, Account and Social teams.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of room to grow. You’ll build analyses and reporting, work directly with teams and clients, and help us continue developing how Data & Analytics shows up across the agency.

We don’t expect you to arrive having done everything on this job description. We care most about strong analytical instincts, curiosity, clear communication and the ability to learn quickly. If you have a solid foundation in marketing analytics and want to broaden into areas like social intelligence, creator measurement, audience insights and creative effectiveness, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Pull, organize and analyze data across campaigns, platforms, audiences, social/content and other relevant sources.  Build reports, dashboards and analyses that make complicated information easy to understand and useful.  Look beyond what happened to investigate why it happened, what it means and what we should do next.  Identify trends, anomalies, audience behaviors, performance gaps and opportunities.  Turn findings into clear insights and recommendations for Strategy, Creative, Account, Social and clients.  Partner closely with Strategy and Creative to connect data to briefs, ideas, content, testing and future decisions.  Help teams understand how work is performing — and where the data may challenge an assumption or point toward a better question.  Contribute to client conversations and grow your ability to present and defend analytical findings.  Help develop measurement approaches for accounts and campaigns alongside Strategy leadership.  Work with and continue building fluency across areas such as social/content analytics, social listening, audience intelligence and creator measurement.  Maintain accuracy and consistency across reporting and data sources. 

Requirements

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

2+ years of experience in analytics, marketing analytics, media analytics, measurement, research, insights or a related discipline.  Hands-on experience working with quantitative marketing or audience data.  Strong analytical instincts and a desire to understand the story behind the numbers.  The ability to move from data → insight → recommendation, not simply report performance.  Strong written and verbal communication skills; you can explain complicated information in plain English.  Experience in at least one relevant area such as campaign analytics, paid social/digital analytics, audience analysis, social/content analytics or marketing measurement.  Comfort working with data in tools such as Excel/Sheets, dashboards, analytics platforms or comparable environments.  Curiosity about brands, advertising, social media, culture and creative work.  A collaborative mindset and an interest in working closely with Creative, Strategy, Account and Social.  Enough confidence to form a point of view — and enough curiosity to change it when the data tells you something new.  A willingness to learn capabilities you may not have worked with yet.

NICE TO HAVE

Agency or client-facing marketing experience.  Experience presenting findings or recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders.  Experience with social listening, audience-intelligence or creator-measurement platforms.  Familiarity with tools such as Meltwater, GWI, Tubular, Brandwatch, Sprinklr or comparable platforms.  Dashboard-building experience.  SQL, Python or other analytical/automation skills.  Experience analyzing creative or content performance.

What Success Looks Like

You produce reliable analysis, but you’re also developing a reputation for finding the interesting thing in the data.You ask good questions, spot patterns other people may miss and can explain why a finding matters without burying the team in numbers.Strategy, Creative, Account and Social teams trust you as a thought partner, not simply the person who produces the report.Over time, you expand your fluency across social, audience, creator and measurement disciplines and take on increasingly complex analytical questions.Most importantly, your work helps Mojo make better-informed creative, strategic and business decisions.

WORKING MODEL

Mojo operates on a hybrid working model, with our team together in our New York City office Tuesday through Thursday.

Benefits

Competitive salary401(k) with up to a 4% company matchMedical, dental, and vision insuranceFlexible paid time off Paid parental leave Culture & wellness StipendFive-week paid sabbatical for employees with five years of serviceTwice monthly team mealsPre-tax commuter benefits

rows.title: Sr. Data Modeler

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

VERSANT is a leading force in news, sports and entertainment - home to iconic and trusted brands that inspire, inform, and delight audiences. Our unique combination of content, technology and services enriches the cultural fabric, igniting passions, sparking conversations, and connecting people to what they love most.

As an independent, publicly traded company, VERSANT brings together powerhouse cable networks - including USA Network, CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Golf Channel - with dynamic digital and direct-to-consumer brands such as Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, GolfPass, and SportsEngine. Together, these businesses reflect our commitment to delivering exceptional experiences across every screen and service.

VERSANT is an industry-changing media company fueled by innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit. With a strong foundation and a forward-looking vision, VERSANT empowers creativity, embraces change, and drives connection in an ever-evolving world.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Data Modeler to define, evolve, and govern our enterprise-wide North Star Data Model. This role will make data consistent, interoperable, discoverable, and reusable across business domains, products, analytics, and AI use cases.

The Senior Data Modeler will work with Product, domain experts, Data Engineering, Analytics, Architecture, Governance, and Security to translate business concepts into a shared enterprise data language and practical models that teams can implement across the Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers of our data platform.

This is not a role focused only on designing tables for individual projects. It owns the connective tissue between domain models: the common entities, identifiers, relationships, definitions, metadata, and standards that allow trusted data products to work together across the enterprise.

What you will do

Establish the enterprise North Star Data Model Define and maintain enterprise conceptual, logical, and physical data models across core business domains. Establish canonical business entities, shared dimensions, reference data, identifiers, relationships, and lifecycle states. Create a pragmatic model that supports domain autonomy while enabling cross-domain analysis and data sharing. Maintain an enterprise ontology, business glossary, and semantic definitions so that important terms and metrics mean the same thing across products and teams. Design for reuse, extensibility, regional variation, and future use cases while avoiding unnecessary centralization. Model the Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers Define modeling principles and required artifacts for each layer:Bronze: Preserve source fidelity, source lineage, ingestion metadata, auditability, and raw-data contracts. Silver: Standardize and validate data; apply common identifiers, canonical entities, conformed dimensions, data-quality rules, and cross-domain integration patterns. Gold: Deliver governed, business-ready data products, semantic models, certified metrics, and analytics-ready structures for dashboards, self-service analysis, and AI. Ensure traceability from Gold metrics and business concepts back through Silver transformations to authoritative Bronze sources. Define clear rules for when a concept belongs in a domain model, the shared enterprise model, a semantic layer, or a product-specific analytical model. Review and guide physical implementations for performance, maintainability, cost, privacy, and scale. 
Enable data products and delivery teams

Partner with Product Managers and domain leaders to turn business outcomes and use cases into clear data-modeling requirements. Partner with Data Engineers to define schemas, transformations, mappings, data contracts, and implementation patterns. Partner with BI developers to create governed semantic models, reusable measures, and self-service-ready datasets. Facilitate architecture and design reviews; identify duplication, inconsistent definitions, broken lineage, and integration risk early. Provide model patterns, templates, and coaching that enable teams to deliver independently while following enterprise standards.Govern for trust, security, and global scale Embed data quality, lineage, ownership, retention, security classification, privacy-by-design, and access-control requirements into data-model designs. Model regional, regulatory, language, currency, and local-business variations without fragmenting global reporting or shared concepts. Define stewardship and decision rights for enterprise entities, metrics, and reference data. Maintain model documentation and metadata in the organization’s data catalog and modeling tools. Measure adoption, reuse, quality, coverage, and exceptions to drive continual improvement of the North Star model. 

What success looks like

Teams use the same definitions for shared business concepts and key metrics. New data products can be delivered faster because common models, dimensions, identifiers, and patterns are reusable. Cross-domain reporting is reliable, explainable, and traceable to authoritative sources. Data consumers can discover what data exists, what it means, who owns it, and whether it is fit for use. Regional expansion is supported through intentional extensions rather than isolated local models. Gold-layer analytics and AI experiences use certified semantic definitions rather than reconstructing logic independently. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

7+ years of experience in data modeling, data architecture, data engineering, analytics engineering, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience designing conceptual, logical, and physical models for complex, multi-domain data platforms. Experience defining or evolving an enterprise data model, canonical model, semantic layer, ontology, or common data model. Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, normalized modeling, data vault or equivalent integration patterns, and lakehouse/warehouse design. Experience designing models for raw, standardized, and consumption-ready data layers in a modern cloud data platform. Proven ability to translate business concepts into unambiguous data definitions, models, mappings, and implementation guidance. Practical expertise in metadata, lineage, data quality, data governance, master/reference data, and data privacy. Strong facilitation and communication skills; able to influence senior stakeholders and delivery teams without relying on direct authority. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Snowflake, or comparable cloud data platforms. Experience with a data catalog, modeling tool, and metadata-management platform. Experience supporting global products and multi-region data, regulatory, or data-residency requirements. Experience designing semantic models and governed metrics for BI, natural-language data experiences, or AI applications. Experience in a regulated, high-scale, or operationally sensitive environment. 

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com.

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

This is a full-time paid internship program spanning ten weeks from June through August 2027. Participation in the internship requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model, for the duration of the program. Interns will be evaluated for a full-time position with their team and will work with their manager on identifying a start date upon graduation

This is a paid internship. This is a limited-time internship position, and Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. However, a full-time Data Science role, for which you may be considered upon completion of the internship (subject to business need, market conditions, and other factors) is eligible for employer immigration sponsorship. 

Basic Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a PhD in one of the following areas with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained by August 2029 or earlier:A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field)Must be continuing in the same course of study of your PhD degree following completion of the internshipAt least 6 months experience or academic work using open source programming languages for data analysisAt least 6 months of experience or academic work using machine learning techniquesAt least 6 months of experience with either Python, R or SQL

Experience or academic work in inferential statisticsExperience or academic work with relational databasesExperience or academic work with large scale data analysis

Data Science Internship - 2027

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a high-performing team that’s embracing the latest in computing technologies to unlock opportunities that help everyday people save money and improve their financial lives. You'll help our customers solve their financial services challenges by using groundbreaking techniques. You'll make valuable contributions from day one by continuously learning, engaging in diverse sets of experiences, and building close-knit relationships across the company. Role / team focus areas could include supporting machine learning, deep learning, or quant initiatives across the enterprise.

On any given day, you might:

Evaluate open-source and internally-developed modeling and analytics tools using real business dataIntegrate internal data with external data sources and APIs to discover and implement actionable insightsDesign and craft data science models to communicate solutions to customers and company leadership

We'd love to find someone who is…

Intellectually curious. You ask why, you explore, and you are excited to imagine and create new ideas by inventing self-adaptive models or by tapping into unstructured data sources. You love mining data for insights into behaviors, intent and sentimentA builder. You are passionate about delivering better experiences and better products to our customers and have a deep sense of ownership for your craft. An experimental scientist. You love putting on your lab coat and trying new things, new combinations of tools, techniques and feature engineering approaches even if you sometimes fail. A Communicator. You seek to connect with teammates and business partners to share technical ideas that resonate with audience needs across verbal and written channels. 

Are you ready to join a community of talented individuals who embrace customer problems and use their passion and capabilities to make a difference every single day? If you're interested in a long-term career at Capital One, the Data Science internship could be a great way to begin your career journey!

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
USDS Financial Crime Compliance is responsible for overseeing and operationalizing all aspects related to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Sanctions Compliance activities related to TikTok USDS's operations. Collaborating cross-functionally with stakeholders across the U.S. and globally, we address complex and cutting-edge challenges, which include the identification of money-laundering, terrorist financing and sanction violations. We seek a highly motivated, experienced, and dynamic professional to join our team.

Responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and optimize machine learning models to detect money laundering, fraud, and other financial crimes, leveraging techniques such as anomaly detection, clustering, and predictive modeling.
- Analyze large volumes of transactional and user data to identify suspicious patterns or behaviors indicative of financial crimes.
- Perform data analysis to support transaction monitoring, sanction, KYC and high-risk investigation teams, including performing ad-hoc data analysis, that assist Financial Crime Compliance leadership in decision-making and strategic planning processes.
- Design and implement data visualization dashboards and reporting tools to communicate insights and findings from financial crime detection efforts.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design, develop, validate, and implement AML scenarios, and conduct threshold tuning to optimize performance.
- Document and manage projects related to threshold tuning, scenario design, and detection methodologies.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and operations to integrate machine learning solutions into existing systems and processes.
- Perform special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Computer Science Engineering or a similar Quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
- 3+ years of experience in data analysis, statistical modeling, machine learning , with a focus on financial crime compliance or related domains.
- Proficiency in programming languages Python, HQL, Neo4J, Spark as well as experience with machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
- Experience with data visualization tools and techniques for creating interactive dashboards and reports (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib).
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with large datasets to extract actionable insights.
- Demonstrate strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems, evaluate information objectively, and communicate well-reasoned conclusions based on evidence and logic.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Ph.D. is a plus
- Familiarity with big data technologies and distributed computing platforms (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).
- Experience working in financial crime compliance, including anti-money laundering (AML).
- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear and concise insights for non-technical stakeholders.

About USDS
TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.

On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


USDS Reasonable Accommodation
USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. Job Description

At American Express, we empower early career data and analytics colleagues to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As an Analyst Data Analytics colleague in Enterprise Technology Services, you will join a full time graduate program and support analytics work that helps technology teams understand portfolio performance, delivery progress, financial trends, resource utilization, and operational outcomes.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, finance, portfolio management, reporting, and data analytics. You may gather and validate data, build reports, analyze financial or delivery metrics, support dashboards, develop insights, and prepare clear recommendations that help leaders and teams make informed technology decisions.

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, validate, and organize data from portfolio, project, financial, operational, and technology delivery sources to support analysis and reporting. Analyze portfolio performance, budget, forecast, resource, delivery, schedule, quality, and risk information to identify trends, insights, and areas for follow up. Create and maintain dashboards, reports, key performance indicators, recurring analytics outputs, and leadership ready summaries for technology stakeholders. Develop financial models, cost views, forecast summaries, scenario analyses, and variance insights that support technology portfolio and project decision making. Partner with technology, finance, product, project, and business teams to understand reporting needs and translate them into accurate analytical outputs. Support Software Development Lifecycle and Agile delivery reporting by analyzing delivery metrics, progress data, dependencies, and execution patterns. Prepare presentations, narratives, and stakeholder updates that communicate data backed insights to technical and non technical audiences. Use Agentic AI, reporting, data analytics, and productivity tools to support research, summarization, analysis, workflow efficiency, and human validated outputs. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications 

Must have earned a Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, or another relevant field before the full time start date.Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027. Interest or experience in data analytics, financial management, portfolio reporting, technology delivery, business intelligence, or data informed decision making. Foundational knowledge of data analytics concepts, including data collection, validation, analysis, visualization, and insight generation. Foundational understanding of financial management principles such as budgeting, forecasting, cost tracking, variance analysis, or financial modeling. Awareness of Software Development Lifecycle and Agile methodology concepts within a technology delivery environment. Foundational understanding of Generative AI concepts, responsible use, appropriate use contexts, prompt based workflows, and human validation of AI generated outputs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, organization, problem solving, and collaboration skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

Coursework, projects, internships, student organizations, or extracurricular experience related to data analytics, finance, business analysis, reporting, portfolio management, or technology delivery. Experience using analytical, reporting, or presentation tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms. Exposure to financial modeling, dashboard development, key performance indicator reporting, forecast reconciliation, cost analysis, or operational analytics. Interest in technology portfolio management, project performance reporting, resource planning, process improvement, or business intelligence modernization. Familiarity with project or portfolio tools such as Jira, Rally, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Project, or related workflow platforms. Coursework, projects, research, or internship exposure to data requirements, source-to-target mapping, data quality and controls, metadata, lineage, or data governance. Exposure to financial modeling, dashboard development, statistical analysis, scenario analysis, model documentation, data quality review, metadata, or data lineage concepts. Interest in AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI, explainability, enterprise data architecture, predictive analytics, or quantum computing research. Curiosity about Agentic AI reporting, AI enabled analytics, productivity tools, automated insight generation, and responsible validation of AI generated recommendations. Ability to build clear narratives from data, communicate findings clearly, and work effectively across finance, technology, architecture, risk, product, and business teams.

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Job Purpose

Fanatics Collectibles is hiring an Associate, People Intelligence to help grow an AI-native people intelligence function. This hands-on, high-impact role sits at the intersection of workforce analytics, data, AI, systems, and process automation, turning people data into decisions and building practical tools and workflows that improve how HR and the business operate.

The ideal candidate pairs strong analytical ability with an AI-native, builder-oriented working style. You should have experience writing SQL; connecting, structuring, and validating data from multiple sources; translating data into a clear story; and using AI to accelerate analytical, technical, and operational work. You will help build internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, dashboards, automations, and repeatable workflows that make people data and People processes easier to use.

You will also design and operate AI-agent workflows, connect AI and automation safely to sensitive people data and enterprise systems, strengthen data, application, and process governance, and partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to simplify, standardize, and automate programs. Success requires the ability to solve ambiguous problems, carry improvements from discovery through implementation, and maintain a team-first mindset. This is a small team with meaningful scope, where you will own work from day one and help shape how the function operates.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain analyses, dashboards, reports, and AI-powered intelligence experiences that answer meaningful workforce questions—including retention, hiring-pipeline health, skills gaps, organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, and employee experience—and give HR, Recruiting, Finance, and business leaders self-service access to reliable, actionable insights.Write SQL to connect, structure, and validate people data across source systems, Snowflake, and downstream tools; support governed data models and data lake and data warehouse environments; and resolve data-quality issues at the root cause.Design, build, test, document, and maintain internal applications, interactive Web App-based documents and tools, AI-agent and automation workflows, prototypes, and self-service experiences that make people data and processes intuitive, secure, repeatable, and auditable.Partner with Employee Lifecycle and other People teams to map and improve end-to-end programs, reducing manual effort, duplicate entry, unnecessary handoffs, control gaps, and employee or manager friction through automation, standardization, and streamlined design.Create and maintain current- and future-state process and data maps, source-to-target mappings, system and data-flow diagrams, data dictionaries, ownership documentation, standard operating procedures, and related technical documentation.Support data, process, and application governance across sensitive people data, AI-enabled solutions, Oracle HCM, workforce-planning platforms, reporting environments, and automation tools—including access, responsible data handling, lineage, quality controls, ownership, requirements, testing, change control, release documentation, issue management, and auditability.Partner with HR, Employee Lifecycle, Finance, business, and technical stakeholders to translate needs into prioritized improvement opportunities and maintain a transparent roadmap across analytics, systems, applications, automation, and process improvement.

What You Bring

1–3+ years of experience in data, analytics, business systems, HR systems, process improvement, automation, or a related technical or analytical role.Proficiency in SQL, with foundational knowledge of data modeling, data structures, and how information moves across systems.Hands-on experience using AI tools, agents, or AI-assisted workflows—such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms—to complete analytical, technical, or operational work.Experience building or prototyping internal tools, automations, Web App-based experiences, or deliverables using code, low-code/no-code platforms, or AI-assisted development.Experience mapping and documenting processes, data flows, system interactions, requirements, controls, and ownership, with a foundational understanding of data privacy, security, role-based access, quality, and governance.Demonstrated ability to identify issues in data, systems, or workflows; carry improvements from problem definition through testing and implementation; and translate stakeholder needs into workable solutions across technical and non-technical teams.Comfort operating in a fluid, fast-moving environment where processes, tools, and standards are still being built, with strong attention to detail and a habit of validating outputs.Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, Organizational Behavior, Computer Science, or another relevant quantitative, technical, or social science field.

KEY TRAITS WE VALUE

AI-native — uses AI tools to move faster and do more, understands their limitations, and has informed opinions about where AI does and does not add value.Product-minded builder — translates ambiguous business problems into simple, usable tools and workflows, improves them based on feedback, and follows through beyond launch.Systems and governance mindset — understands how data, processes, systems, controls, and decisions connect and moves quickly without sacrificing security, quality, documentation, appropriate access, or process discipline.Technically self-sufficient — can take work from data pull or problem definition through testing, documentation, and clean output, with appropriate support and escalation.Curious about people, not just data — wants to understand what the numbers, systems, and process outcomes mean for employees, managers, and the organization.

These teams use advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI to solve complex problems, uncover insights from large datasets, and develop innovative solutions that support Tradeweb’s products, clients, and businesses.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

 Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.  Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”  Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.  Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .  Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .  AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.  Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.  Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.  Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.  Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.  Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome! 


 Position Type 

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

 Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York  Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans  401K with company match  Generous paid Parental Leave  Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases  Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities  Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)  Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building  NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program  Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties  Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options 


 Our Commitment 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation

rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Product Specialist, Product Management, Global Consumer Credit Commercialization

Overview

Mastercard’s Global Consumer Credit team is responsible for developing and commercializing consumer credit products, value propositions, and related capabilities that help our partners drive portfolio growth, deepen cardholder engagement, and deliver differentiated consumer experiences. The team supports a broad set of global priorities for affluent and non-affluent consumer credit products, including key value propositions such as The Mastercard Collection, and focuses on sales enablement, customer engagement, market insights, and performance tracking.

Role

The Product Specialist will support the execution of global commercialization priorities for consumer credit products. This role will help to create sales enablement materials, support customer engagement efforts, identify actionable insights, assist with marketing strategies, and maintain reporting.

In This Role, You Will

 Support the execution of the global consumer credit commercialization strategy for affluent and non-affluent credit products. Develop, maintain, and refresh sales enablement materials, commercialization toolkits, customer-facing narratives, and internal education materials that help regional teams and account managers with positioning Mastercard consumer credit products effectively. Support critical consumer credit RFPs and strategic customer meetings by coordinating inputs, compiling insights, and helping to create clear and compelling materials in partnership with cross-functional contributors. Help build customer and segment-specific materials that communicate the value of Mastercard consumer credit products, including value proposition articulation, issuer benefits, cardholder benefits, product differentiation, and commercial relevance. Support the development of case studies, proof points, success stories, and examples that demonstrate the value and impact of Mastercard consumer credit products and commercialization initiatives. Track market, issuer, and competitor activity across affluent and non-affluent credit, synthesizing relevant trends and insights into clear summaries that can inform sales enablement, RFP responses, and commercialization recommendations. Maintain commercialization trackers, KPI reporting, pipeline views, and other tools that improve visibility into consumer credit commercialization activity, regional progress, sales enablement needs, and business performance. Extract and analyze performance data, market information, and regional feedback to identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and recommendations that support commercialization execution. Contribute to the development and improvement of repeatable commercialization processes, tools, templates, and knowledge resources that increase consistency, quality, and scalability across global and regional teams. Coordinate operating activity for global consumer credit commercialization, including recurring updates, regional input collection, action tracking, and material refresh updates. Support leadership updates, business reviews, internal communications, and stakeholder materials by synthesizing complex inputs into clear, concise, well-structured outputs. Support ad hoc strategic and executional requests. Partner cross-functionally with global and regional Product, Sales, Marketing, Services, Finance, Legal, regional teams.


About You

 Experience supporting commercialization, sales enablement, strategy, or consulting is preferred. Strong execution mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate inputs across stakeholders, maintain high-quality outputs, and deliver work on time in a fast-moving environment. Strong analytical orientation, with the ability to maintain trackers, synthesize data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, structured, outputs that can be adapted for internal and customer-facing audiences. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to maintain tools, templates, trackers, reporting, content repositories, and governance processes that support consistent execution across teams. Comfortable working across global, regional, and matrixed teams with the ability to build effective working relationships. Proactive, dependable, and comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a willingness to take ownership of defined workstreams, propose solutions, and follow through to completion. Demonstrates curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, commitment to continuous learning, and the ability to bring structure and clarity to complex business topics.


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.



Job Description

NBCUniversal’s Data & Legal Solutions team operates as a central program operations group embedded across Ad Sales, Direct to Consumer, Distribution, Marketing, Research, Technology, Legal, and HR as trusted partners working together to implement strategic programs throughout the enterprise to effectively close gaps between central business and technology groups across a variety of projects.  We work to provide relevant insights & structure across our diverse portfolio to power intelligent business decisions required to compete within today’s extraordinarily complex multi-platform & fragmented media landscape.   

NBCUniversal is seeking a highly motivated Senior Business Analyst – Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) to own and evolve our enterprise contract management platform. This role serves as the primary business lead for CLM capabilities, partnering with Legal, Sourcing, Studios, Privacy, Compliance, and Technology teams to streamline contract processes, drive platform adoption, and deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, compliance, and business outcomes. 

The successful candidate will act as the configuration lead for CLM, translating business needs into scalable workflows, managing vendor relationships, driving roadmap priorities, and helping shape NBCUniversal’s next generation of AI-enabled contract management capabilities. The role supports the continued evolution of enterprise CLM, contract intake modernization, workflow automation, reporting, integrations, and enterprise expansion initiatives. 

Responsibilities:

CLM Platform OwnershipServe as the primary business owner for the CLM platform (Malbek). Manage and prioritize the CLM enhancement backlog and roadmap. Configure workflows, templates, clause libraries, metadata models, approval routing, and reporting capabilities. Partner with application support and vendors to troubleshoot issues and implement enhancements. Identify opportunities to improve contract lifecycle efficiency and user experience. Business Analysis & Solution DeliveryLead requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders across Legal, Procurement, Studios, Media, and Corporate functions. Document business processes, future-state workflows, functional requirements, and solution designs. Conduct fit-gap assessments and make recommendations for process and technology improvements. Support testing, release management, training, and change adoption activities. Enterprise Contract TransformationDrive expansion of CLM capabilities across new business units and use cases. Support intake modernization, workflow standardization, and governance initiatives. Partner with Legal Operations and Technology teams to establish scalable contract management practices. Develop KPIs and reporting to measure adoption, efficiency, and business value. AI & Innovation Evaluate and implement AI-enabled contracting capabilities, including drafting support, clause analysis, contract summarization, semantic search, and metadata automation. Partner with enterprise AI teams and vendors to identify new use cases and productivity opportunities. Support pilot programs and business case development for emerging CLM technologies. Stakeholder ManagementAct as trusted advisor to Legal, Procurement, Operations, Privacy, Records Management, and Compliance stakeholders. Facilitate executive updates, roadmap reviews, and steering committee discussions. Coordinate across product, operations, vendor, and technology teams to ensure successful delivery. 

Qualifications

Requirements:

At American Express, we empower early career data and analytics colleagues to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. Responsibilities

Develop financial models, cost views, forecast summaries, scenario analyses, and variance insights that support technology portfolio and project decision making. Qualifications

Must have earned a Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, or another relevant field before the full time start date.Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, organization, problem solving, and collaboration skills.

Coursework, projects, internships, student organizations, or extracurricular experience related to data analytics, finance, business analysis, reporting, portfolio management, or technology delivery. Curiosity about Agentic AI reporting, AI enabled analytics, productivity tools, automated insight generation, and responsible validation of AI generated recommendations. Who We AreadMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines.
Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking.
Our award-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike.
The RoleadMarketplace is looking for a curious, analytical, and highly motivated Graduate Data Analyst to join our Measurement & Insights organization.
This is an early-career development role designed for someone who wants to build a career at the intersection of data, technology, product, and digital advertising. You'll begin with well-scoped analytical problems and progressively take ownership of more ambiguous work.You'll work alongside Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Marketing Scientists, Product Managers, Engineers, and commercial teams to solve real problems using real marketplace data.
As your skills and interests develop, we'll help you build toward one of several career paths:Analytics Engineering - building trusted datasets, metrics, and self-service analytics.Data Science & Product Analytics - experimentation, causal analysis, product insights, and marketplace science.Marketing Science - advertising measurement, incrementality, experimentation, and client-facing insights.You aren't expected to know which path is right for you on day one. Part of the job is figuring that out.
What You'll DoLearn Our Business & Data - Develop a strong understanding of adMarketplace, our marketplace, core datasets, metrics, and Enterprise Data Model.Analyze Real Business Questions - Use SQL to investigate product and marketplace performance, identify drivers, analyze trends, and communicate findings.Build Trusted Analytics - Help develop reusable datasets, QA metrics, document definitions, and turn recurring analyses into scalable analytics.Learn Experimentation & Data Science - Support experiments, analyze A/B tests, and gain exposure to statistics, causal inference, Python/R, and marketplace science.Learn Marketing Science - Support advertising-effectiveness and incrementality studies, including experimental QA and client-facing analyses.Build Reusable Solutions - Look for opportunities to automate recurring work and use modern analytical and AI tools to make the team more effective.
What We're Looking ForWe care more about your analytical potential and ability to learn than having years of experience.
You might be a recent graduate, completing your degree, or at the very beginning of your career.
We're looking for:Bachelor's or master's degree-or equivalent experience-in a quantitative or analytical field.Experience working with data through coursework, internships, research, projects, or professional work.Basic SQL knowledge or demonstrated ability to learn technical tools quickly.Strong quantitative reasoning and problem-solving skills.Curiosity about how products and businesses work, not just the data they generate.Clear communication and willingness to ask questions and challenge assumptions.Motivation to learn unfamiliar tools, techniques, and domains.
Nice to Have - But Definitely Not RequiredPython or R.SQL beyond introductory coursework.Statistics or experimental-design experience.Data visualization experience.Exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Sigma, Tableau, or similar tools.Experience working with real-world datasets.Interest in advertising, marketplaces, search, or digital products.
We do not expect graduate candidates to arrive knowing all of these technologies. That's part of what you'll learn here.
Join UsadMarketplace has been named as one of the best places to work in New York City by Built In and Crain’s- the latter of which have recognized us the past three years straight! AMP is currently experiencing triple digit growth, and it’s never been a better time to join our team!We offer a robust continuing education program, management training, regular company-wide lunch and learns, and well-defined career paths to ensure all our employees have an opportunity to grow.
At adMarketplace, we play to win, but we learn from our setbacks. Our commitment to a collaborative environment means no one succeeds alone, and no one fails alone either.We know you’ve come to expect comprehensive healthcare, wellness programs, paid time off, commuter benefits, and 401k matching from any company, so it’s a good thing we offer all of that and so much more. adMarketplace offers Summer Fridays, catered lunches, a fully stocked kitchen, ZogSports teams, happy hours and corporate retreats to encourage a strong work/life balance.
No Third Party Recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
*This range represents the low and high end of the base salary someone in this role may earn as an employee of adMarketplace in the New York office. Salaries will vary based on various factors including but not limited to professional and academic experience; training; associated responsibilities; and other business and organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of our total compensation package for employees. Salary decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each hire.

Comfort working with data in tools such as Excel/Sheets, dashboards, analytics platforms or comparable environments.  Curiosity about brands, advertising, social media, culture and creative work.
