rows.title: Media Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Launch Your Career with Cool Clients, Creative Campaigns, and Cutting-Edge Data
Forget the clichés about advertising. You don’t need a marketing degree to succeed here. Sure, we hire people with degrees in marketing and business. But some of our best employees have also come from backgrounds in neuroscience, finance, psychology, and music—and members of our team are also DJs, cake bosses, bedazzlers, world travelers, rock singers, athletes, and poets. At Gupta Media, your quirks add to your qualifications. If you don’t fit into a box, you’ll fit in perfectly.
About UsGupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning), major sports franchises (X Games, Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).
The RoleAs a Media Coordinator, you’ll play a key role in launching paid media campaigns, analyzing results, and making data-driven decisions to deliver exceptional client outcomes. Our hands-on Medley:Onramp training program will teach you everything you need to know about platforms like Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok, plus the strategies that make them work.
Here’s what you’ll do:Master Digital Marketing: Build, optimize, and manage campaigns across top platforms. You’ll learn how to target audiences, A/B test ad copy, and measure success using metrics like CPM, CPC, CPV, and CPA.Communicate with Confidence: Develop the skills to interpret complex data and share insights that matter. Whether crafting a report or explaining trends to clients, your ability to tell a story with numbers will set you apart.Leverage Analytics: Data is at the heart of everything we do. You’ll work with tools like Excel, Google Sheets, and Google Analytics while applying formulas, functions, and calculations to uncover trends, solve problems, and deliver results. If you enjoy predicting outcomes (be it a fantasy league or Dancing with the Stars), you’ll feel right at home.
Who You AreWe’re looking for recent grads who bring energy, curiosity, and a can-do attitude. You…Have a Bachelor’s degree with a minimum GPA of 3.3.Have a passion for marketing and advertising, along with a desire to dig deeper into what makes good advertising great.Possess a solid working knowledge of spreadsheets (know the basic functions and an advanced formula or two).Enjoy diving into and talking about data, numbers, rates, and what they could all mean for your clients and campaigns.Thrive in fast-paced environments and manage multiple priorities like a pro.Are a leader in your own right—whether you captained a team, led a student org, or carried group projects across the finish line.Have a drive to keep learning, growing, and asking “what’s next?"
Why Gupta?At Gupta Media, we believe in fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and a little bit of competition (ask about our summer softball leagues). We prioritize in-office work because we know that the best ideas happen when we’re working together. Beyond the work, we’re passionate about supporting a diverse and inclusive environment that celebrates different perspectives.
How to ApplyLet’s skip the generic cover letter. Instead, we want to see:Your resume, of course.A supplemental response that shares with us a glimpse into why this type of role is right for you. You’ll have a choice of prompts, so pick the one that checks your boxes and give us your best answer. We will read them!
Work EnvironmentGupta Media is an office-first organization.
CompensationAt Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $58,000 - $62,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.
We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the US for at least 3 years.

rows.title: Intern, Damages & Valuations (Summer 2027)
rows.descriptionText:
Chart Your Journey at Secretariat

From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat.

About The Firm

Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world.

From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions.

Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat.

ABOUT Our Damages & Valuations Team

Our Damages & Valuations team sits at the intersection of finance, data, strategy, and the law. We help clients answer high-stakes questions when businesses, investors, and legal teams need to understand what something is worth, how much money may have been lost, and what the financial evidence really shows. Our work supports complex disputes, arbitration matters, and business challenges around the world—giving team members exposure to real-world problems where their analysis can directly influence important decisions.

As part of this team, you will collaborate with accountants, economists, PhDs, business valuation experts, investment analysts, and industry specialists to investigate complex issues, analyze data, and translate financial information into clear, persuasive insights. It is challenging, fast-moving work that helps early-career professionals build consulting skills quickly, learn from recognized experts, and see how their work connects to major business and legal outcomes. The team’s work is highly regarded: Secretariat was ranked #1 in Global Arbitration Review’s Expert Witness Firm Power Index in 2024 and 2025, and more than 90% of our testifying experts are recognized as leading experts by Who's Who Legal.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be part of a growing domestic and international practice where strong analytical thinking, curiosity, creativity, and clear communication are essential. Associates are actively involved in meaningful project work from the start—helping the team uncover facts, analyze financial information, and develop insights that support high-stakes client matters.

Dig into case documents, research materials, and discovery records to understand the facts behind complex disputesAnalyze financial statements, business records, market data, and other evidence to help quantify damages and support valuation workBuild models, organize data, and develop analyses that help explain financial issues clearly and accuratelyContribute to reports, presentations, and client-ready materials that turn detailed analysis into compelling insightsWork closely with senior consultants and experts, gaining hands-on experience in litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, and economic consulting

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving puzzles, working with numbers, asking thoughtful questions, and learning how financial analysis can make a real impact in business and legal settings. The ideal candidate is coachable, intellectually curious, detail-oriented, and excited to grow in a collaborative consulting environment.

Qualifications

Pursuing bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or another analytically rigorous discipline from an accredited college or universityExpected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn new concepts and ask thoughtful questionsInterest or experience in economic consulting, litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, finance, accounting, data analysis, or other research-intensive workExperience with research projects, undergraduate theses, consulting internships, data analytics internships, finance-related work, or similar experiences that demonstrate ownership of complex workProficiency in Excel; familiarity with tools such as Stata, R, Python, or SQL is helpful, along with an eagerness to continue building technical skillsComfort working with data, conducting research, organizing information clearly, and using emerging tools, including AI, to improve efficiency, quality, and analytical rigorStrong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to balance multiple assignments and communicate proactivelyAbility to stay focused, adaptable, and solutions-oriented when priorities shift or deadlines are tightClear listening, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a thoughtful and professional way; fluency in English for business communication is requiredInterest in professional development or credentials such as CPA, CFA, CVA, or ASA is a plus, but not required to applyAuthorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship

At Secretariat, we believe in pay transparency and equity. Compensation for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, and location. Further details will be provided during the hiring process.

Pay Transparency

$20—$30 USD

A rewarding career above all

There are a lot of fine consulting firms out there. But when everything is on the line, it takes a unique combination of skill and savvy to succeed under pressure.

Our culture and people are driven by passion, pride, and performance. Passion for the clients we serve, the work we deliver, and the communities we live in. Pride in our cohesive team recognized for excellence and trusted to perform in the most challenging situations. And our track record of outstanding performance across all of our disciplines speaks for itself.

Our people are motivated to be the best in everything they do – from our approach to making the complex simple to the way we mentor our up-and-coming talent to become trusted experts early in their careers.

About Stellix

Stellix helps organizations in the life sciences and other critical industries connect strategy, systems, and teams so they can turn digital and AI investments into measurable operational results. Join our team as we design, implement, and govern the adaptive operating models that produce outcomes that matter to our clients and the communities they serve.

Role Summary

We are seeking a motivated recent college graduate to join our team and help accelerate the application of AI across Stellix’s enterprise knowledge platform. This is a hands-on, entry-level role for someone who is curious about how AI can transform the way a consulting and engineering firm captures, organizes, and reuses its institutional expertise.

Stellix’s knowledge platform is built on Glean and connects SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Confluence, Salesforce, Smartsheet, and other enterprise systems into a unified search, AI assistant, and agent environment. The long-term vision is to build a compounding knowledge platform that captures expertise from every engagement and turns it into reusable intellectual property — so each project makes the next project better.

As an AI Knowledge Platform Associate, you will work alongside our IT, Digital Platforms, and business teams to build, test, and refine Glean agents; structure and curate knowledge content; support AI workflow development; and help drive adoption across the organization. You will gain hands-on experience with enterprise AI tools, agentic workflows, and knowledge management while contributing to real business outcomes.

This is an ideal role for a recent graduate who is excited about applied AI, comfortable working across technical and business contexts, and eager to learn how AI works inside a real consulting and engineering organization.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Building & Refinement

Build, test, and refine Glean agents that automate multi-step workflows such as contract review, proposal development, knowledge retrieval, and document generation.Translate business requirements into clear agent instructions, step logic, and workflow configurations.Evaluate agent outputs for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with business needs, and iterate on prompts and configurations to improve quality.Document agent designs, use cases, and operating instructions so they can be maintained and scaled.

Knowledge Structure & Curation

Help organize, tag, and structure content across connected data sources (SharePoint, Confluence, Salesforce, Smartsheet, etc.) to improve search relevance and AI-assisted retrieval.Support the development of Glean Collections and curated knowledge groupings that make expertise easier to find and reuse.Assist in identifying knowledge gaps and working with subject matter experts to fill them.Contribute to the ongoing effort to convert workflows, implementation patterns, and operational learnings into structured, reusable IP.

AI Workflow & Solution Support

Support the design and delivery of AI-enabled workflows using Glean, Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, and related platforms.Assist in building rapid prototypes and pilots that demonstrate value quickly.Help evaluate new AI features and capabilities as they are released across the platform.Participate in testing and quality assurance for new agents, workflows, and AI features before deployment.

Adoption & Enablement

Support the “Learn More About AI” recurring series by helping prepare demos, examples, and training materials.Assist with user onboarding to the Glean platform, including setup guidance and feature walkthroughs.Gather user feedback, identify friction points, and help translate them into improvement actions.Contribute to internal communications that highlight AI wins and encourage broader adoption.

Governance & Documentation

Follow established AI governance processes, content-handling rules, and guardrails for all work on the platform.Help maintain documentation of agents, workflows, data sources, and permissions.Support audit readiness by ensuring configurations are well-documented and aligned with enterprise standards.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree (recent graduate or graduating by start date) in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.Strong academic record with coursework or projects involving AI, machine learning, data management, or enterprise systems.

Required Skills

Demonstrated interest in applied AI, enterprise search, or knowledge management.Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar platforms through coursework, internships, or personal projects.Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.Analytical mindset with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured steps.Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve and learning is continuous.High attention to detail and a willingness to iterate.

Preferred Qualifications

Internship or co-op experience in an IT, digital transformation, or consulting environment.Exposure to enterprise platforms such as SharePoint, Confluence, Salesforce, or Smartsheet.Experience building workflows, automation, or no-code/low-code solutions (e.g., Power Automate, Zapier, or similar).Familiarity with concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, prompt design, or agent orchestration.Experience creating documentation, training materials, or knowledge base content.

What You Will Learn

How enterprise AI platforms work in practice — not just demos, but real workflows serving real users.How to build and refine AI agents using Glean’s Agent Builder, including multi-step orchestration, branching logic, and human-in-the-loop approval patterns.How to structure and curate knowledge so that AI delivers accurate, relevant, and governed results.How a consulting and engineering firm captures expertise from projects and turns it into reusable IP.How to work across technical and business teams to identify opportunities, prototype solutions, and drive adoption.

Here’s What You’ll Get

Highly competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision InsuranceFlexible Spending or Health Savings AccountsUnlimited Vacation Time10 Paid Holidays12 Paid Weeks Birthing Parent LeavePet InsuranceRetirement Savings: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership PlanEmployee Referral BonusProfessional Development ReimbursementCompany Paid STD, LTD, and Life Insurance

rows.title: AI Knowledge Platform Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Stellix

Stellix helps organizations in the life sciences and other critical industries connect strategy, systems, and teams so they can turn digital and AI investments into measurable operational results. Join our team as we design, implement, and govern the adaptive operating models that produce outcomes that matter to our clients and the communities they serve.

Role Summary

We are seeking a motivated recent college graduate to join our team and help accelerate the application of AI across Stellix’s enterprise knowledge platform. This is a hands-on, entry-level role for someone who is curious about how AI can transform the way a consulting and engineering firm captures, organizes, and reuses its institutional expertise.

Stellix’s knowledge platform is built on Glean and connects SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Confluence, Salesforce, Smartsheet, and other enterprise systems into a unified search, AI assistant, and agent environment. The long-term vision is to build a compounding knowledge platform that captures expertise from every engagement and turns it into reusable intellectual property — so each project makes the next project better.

As an AI Knowledge Platform Associate, you will work alongside our IT, Digital Platforms, and business teams to build, test, and refine Glean agents; structure and curate knowledge content; support AI workflow development; and help drive adoption across the organization. You will gain hands-on experience with enterprise AI tools, agentic workflows, and knowledge management while contributing to real business outcomes.

This is an ideal role for a recent graduate who is excited about applied AI, comfortable working across technical and business contexts, and eager to learn how AI works inside a real consulting and engineering organization.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Building & Refinement

Build, test, and refine Glean agents that automate multi-step workflows such as contract review, proposal development, knowledge retrieval, and document generation.Translate business requirements into clear agent instructions, step logic, and workflow configurations.Evaluate agent outputs for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with business needs, and iterate on prompts and configurations to improve quality.Document agent designs, use cases, and operating instructions so they can be maintained and scaled.

Knowledge Structure & Curation

Help organize, tag, and structure content across connected data sources (SharePoint, Confluence, Salesforce, Smartsheet, etc.) to improve search relevance and AI-assisted retrieval.Support the development of Glean Collections and curated knowledge groupings that make expertise easier to find and reuse.Assist in identifying knowledge gaps and working with subject matter experts to fill them.Contribute to the ongoing effort to convert workflows, implementation patterns, and operational learnings into structured, reusable IP.

AI Workflow & Solution Support

Support the design and delivery of AI-enabled workflows using Glean, Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, and related platforms.Assist in building rapid prototypes and pilots that demonstrate value quickly.Help evaluate new AI features and capabilities as they are released across the platform.Participate in testing and quality assurance for new agents, workflows, and AI features before deployment.

Adoption & Enablement

Support the “Learn More About AI” recurring series by helping prepare demos, examples, and training materials.Assist with user onboarding to the Glean platform, including setup guidance and feature walkthroughs.Gather user feedback, identify friction points, and help translate them into improvement actions.Contribute to internal communications that highlight AI wins and encourage broader adoption.

Governance & Documentation

Follow established AI governance processes, content-handling rules, and guardrails for all work on the platform.Help maintain documentation of agents, workflows, data sources, and permissions.Support audit readiness by ensuring configurations are well-documented and aligned with enterprise standards.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree (recent graduate or graduating by start date) in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.Strong academic record with coursework or projects involving AI, machine learning, data management, or enterprise systems.

Required Skills

Demonstrated interest in applied AI, enterprise search, or knowledge management.Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar platforms through coursework, internships, or personal projects.Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.Analytical mindset with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured steps.Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve and learning is continuous.High attention to detail and a willingness to iterate.

Preferred Qualifications

Internship or co-op experience in an IT, digital transformation, or consulting environment.Exposure to enterprise platforms such as SharePoint, Confluence, Salesforce, or Smartsheet.Experience building workflows, automation, or no-code/low-code solutions (e.g., Power Automate, Zapier, or similar).Familiarity with concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, prompt design, or agent orchestration.Experience creating documentation, training materials, or knowledge base content.

What You Will Learn

How enterprise AI platforms work in practice — not just demos, but real workflows serving real users.How to build and refine AI agents using Glean’s Agent Builder, including multi-step orchestration, branching logic, and human-in-the-loop approval patterns.How to structure and curate knowledge so that AI delivers accurate, relevant, and governed results.How a consulting and engineering firm captures expertise from projects and turns it into reusable IP.How to work across technical and business teams to identify opportunities, prototype solutions, and drive adoption.

Here’s What You’ll Get

Highly competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision InsuranceFlexible Spending or Health Savings AccountsUnlimited Vacation Time10 Paid Holidays12 Paid Weeks Birthing Parent LeavePet InsuranceRetirement Savings: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership PlanEmployee Referral BonusProfessional Development ReimbursementCompany Paid STD, LTD, and Life Insurance

The posted salary range represents a good faith estimate of the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and business needs.

On-Site Requirements

This position requires a full on-site presence 5 days per week during the first 4–6 months. Following that period, the role will be on-site four days per week, including Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with the fourth on-site day alternating between Tuesday or Friday depending on business needs.

Must be currently authorized to work in the United States.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning), major sports franchises (X Games, Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).
We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.
The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.
Who You Are:You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any questionYou bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basisYou are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plusYou communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaningYou have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus
What You’ll Do:Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. Company Overview:Cerulli Associates (CA) is a research and consulting firm, headquartered in Boston, specializing in product and distribution analysis for the global asset management industry. Since 1992, we have blended primary research and data analysis to bring perspective to current market conditions and forecasts for future developments. With a suite of research publications, an interactive data platform, and custom research and consulting offerings, we provide financial services firms with unparalleled guidance in strategic positioning and new business development.
Cerulli Associates is a 2023, 2024, and 2025 Boston Globe Top Places to Work. We are proud to be recognized for our outstanding employee engagement, management, work-life balance, and benefits.
Our clients include virtually all the top 50 global asset management firms, as well as industry service providers, management consulting companies, banks, broker/dealers, insurance companies, investment consulting firms, and private equity firms.
Position Overview:The Data Automation Analyst will help expand and strengthen Cerulli Associates’ data automation capabilities. Their primary focus will be on reusable data-processing, benchmarking, reporting, and validation workflows that support the firm’s research, publishing, and consulting work.

This person will work within an evolving modern data environment, contribute to the adoption of stronger data and development practices, and help improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of Cerulli’s data products and workflows. This role will help strengthen the reliable, reusable data foundation needed for analytics, automation, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.
This role is designed for someone with experience working with real business data and recurring workflows who wants to grow from strong implementation into greater technical ownership and solution development. Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data analytics, information systems, statistics, or a related field2 to 4 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, data engineering, process automation, business intelligence, or a related field; candidates with at least 1 year of especially relevant experience may be consideredStrong fundamentals in Python and SQLAbility to troubleshoot systematically and communicate findings clearlyAbility to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, ask effective questions, and challenge assumptions constructivelyExperience with dbt, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Git, or similar data platforms and development practices is preferredExperience with survey data, longitudinal data, wide datasets, configurable reporting, or automated document generation is preferredExperience with financial services, market research, publishing, consulting, or data products is a plus
Salary:$80,000 – $100,000

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

TSD Mobility Solutions, Inc., an affiliate of Reynolds and Reynolds, is looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will turn sales, revenue, and margin data into dashboards and executive reports that leadership relies on; own the team's operational automations; and maintain the configuration behind TSD's payments platform. You will be responsible for monthly sales reporting and rep attribution hygiene by maintaining payments reporting (including rate, margin pools, and volume trends). You will build pivot-ready datasets, macros, and automated workflows in Excel, Power Query, and Google Sheets, and take ownership of existing automations that report team stats.

Take ownership of existing automations that report team stats.Route escalations and handle metadata attribution.Manage monthly payments account maintenance, including pricing adjustments and configuration updates.Flag anomalies affecting billing or margin.Maintain, troubleshoot, and extend these automations as reporting and operational needs evolve.Build repeatable workflows to extract cost, interchange, and margin insights from raw merchant processor statements.

Training

On the job training.



Requirements

2+ years of experience in a similar data analyst position requiredAdvanced experience in excel (pivots, macros/VBA, complex formulas), Power Query, and Google Sheets requiredExperience building and maintaining recurring dashboards and reporting from sales, revenue, and margin data requiredHands-on experience with workflow automation tools (Zapier or similar) and able to troubleshoot and extend existing automations requiredPower user of AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to automate and accelerate daily work requiredExperience with Stripe or another payments platform configuration preferredIndustry background in payments, fintech, SaaS, or mobility/rental is a plusCollege Degree in relevant field preferredExperience in SQL, Python, and CRM systems like HubSpot or Salesforce is a plusStrong attention to detail and documentation habitsExcellent written and verbal communication skills

Benefits

Benefits

We strive to offer an environment that provides our associates with the right balance between work and family. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

 Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a health savings account 401(k) with up to 6% matching Professional development and training Promotion from within Reynolds offers a hybrid work schedule, based on position eligibility. Following completion of your training period, eligible associates may work-from-home up to two days per week. Paid vacation and sick days Eight paid holidays Referral bonuses

Reynolds and Reynolds promotes a healthy lifestyle by providing a non-smoking environment. Reynolds and Reynolds is an equal opportunity employer.

rows.title: 2027 Spring Co-op mRNA Drug Substance Process Characterization Data Analytics and Visualization,
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: 2027 Spring Co-op mRNA Drug Substance Process Characterization Data Analytics and Visualization

Grade: Co-opLocation: Waltham, MADuration: 6 months


About The Job

Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Join Sanofi for a chance to develop with mentoring and guidance from inspirational leaders while helping to make an impact on the lives of countless people worldwide. We are seeking a highly motivated Spring Co-op to join our mRNA Drug Substance Process Characterization Data Analytics and Visualization team.

This role focuses on developing tools and workflows to analyze, visualize, and streamline analytical data generated in support of mRNA drug substance process development. You will work closely with a team of scientists responsible for routine and development-stage analytical assays, including HPLC, LCMS, ELISA, qPCR, and electrophoretic methods. The primary goal of this internship is to improve how analytical data is processed, interpreted, and communicatedenabling faster decision-making and increased throughput. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of analytical chemistry/biochemistry and data science, with opportunities to directly impact development decisions, lab operations, assay performance tracking, and data integrity.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, youll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

About Sanofi

Were an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving peoples lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve peoples lives.

Main Responsibilities

Design and implement data analysis and visualization tools for analytical datasets (e.g., HPLC, LCMS, ELISA, qPCR).Build automated workflows for data ingestion, cleaning, and transformation from instrument outputs or shared databases.Develop intuitive data visualization dashboards (e.g. Power BI) for assay output, performance, trends, and control.Support statistical analysis of assay performance (e.g., accuracy, precision, linearity).Collaborate with scientists to understand pain points and translate them into practical data-based solutions.Document tools and workflows for internal use and scalability.


About You

Basic Qualifications:

Currently pursuing a Masters or PhD in: Biochemistry, Chemical Biology, Analytical Chemistry, Bioengineering, Data Science, or related field.Must be permanently authorized to work in the U.S. and not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually require future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the Internal requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long-term status that does not require company sponsorship.Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the duration of the co-op/internship.Must be able to relocate to the office location and work 40hrs/week, Monday to Friday for the full duration of the co-op/internship.


PreferredQualifications

Strong quantitative background with experience in data analysis, statistics and visualization.Proficiency in at least one of the following: Python (pandas, numpy, matplotlib/seaborn, plotly), R (tidyverse, ggplot2) and MATLAB.Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data.Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.Effective communication skills, with the ability to translate technical results to non-experts.Experience working with analytical laboratory data, such as: Chromatography (HPLC/UPLC)/ LCMS/ or plate-based assaysFamiliarity with analytical software platforms (e.g., Chromeleon, OpenLab, MassHunter, SoftMax Pro).Experience with scientific data pipelines or ETL workflows.Knowledge of assay validation principles (e.g., ICH Q2 guidelines)Experience with: Building dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Dash, Streamlit), time-series analysis or process monitoring and handling large datasets or high-throughput workflows.Exposure to biologics or mRNA-related analytical methods.Interest in laboratory operations, automation, or workflow optimization.


Why Choose Us

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team.Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.


Compensation

The salary range for this position is$35.00 -$58.00hourly. All compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience.

rows.title: AI Knowledge Platform Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Stellix

Stellix helps organizations in the life sciences and other critical industries connect strategy, systems, and teams so they can turn digital and AI investments into measurable operational results. Join our team as we design, implement, and govern the adaptive operating models that produce outcomes that matter to our clients and the communities they serve.

Role Summary

We are seeking a motivated recent college graduate to join our team and help accelerate the application of AI across Stellix’s enterprise knowledge platform. This is a hands-on, entry-level role for someone who is curious about how AI can transform the way a consulting and engineering firm captures, organizes, and reuses its institutional expertise.

Stellix’s knowledge platform is built on Glean and connects SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Confluence, Salesforce, Smartsheet, and other enterprise systems into a unified search, AI assistant, and agent environment. The long-term vision is to build a compounding knowledge platform that captures expertise from every engagement and turns it into reusable intellectual property — so each project makes the next project better.

As an AI Knowledge Platform Associate, you will work alongside our IT, Digital Platforms, and business teams to build, test, and refine Glean agents; structure and curate knowledge content; support AI workflow development; and help drive adoption across the organization. You will gain hands-on experience with enterprise AI tools, agentic workflows, and knowledge management while contributing to real business outcomes.

This is an ideal role for a recent graduate who is excited about applied AI, comfortable working across technical and business contexts, and eager to learn how AI works inside a real consulting and engineering organization.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Building & Refinement

Build, test, and refine Glean agents that automate multi-step workflows such as contract review, proposal development, knowledge retrieval, and document generation.Translate business requirements into clear agent instructions, step logic, and workflow configurations.Evaluate agent outputs for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with business needs, and iterate on prompts and configurations to improve quality.Document agent designs, use cases, and operating instructions so they can be maintained and scaled.

Knowledge Structure & Curation

Help organize, tag, and structure content across connected data sources (SharePoint, Confluence, Salesforce, Smartsheet, etc.) to improve search relevance and AI-assisted retrieval.Support the development of Glean Collections and curated knowledge groupings that make expertise easier to find and reuse.Assist in identifying knowledge gaps and working with subject matter experts to fill them.Contribute to the ongoing effort to convert workflows, implementation patterns, and operational learnings into structured, reusable IP.

AI Workflow & Solution Support

Support the design and delivery of AI-enabled workflows using Glean, Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, and related platforms.Assist in building rapid prototypes and pilots that demonstrate value quickly.Help evaluate new AI features and capabilities as they are released across the platform.Participate in testing and quality assurance for new agents, workflows, and AI features before deployment.

Adoption & Enablement

Support the “Learn More About AI” recurring series by helping prepare demos, examples, and training materials.Assist with user onboarding to the Glean platform, including setup guidance and feature walkthroughs.Gather user feedback, identify friction points, and help translate them into improvement actions.Contribute to internal communications that highlight AI wins and encourage broader adoption.

Governance & Documentation

Follow established AI governance processes, content-handling rules, and guardrails for all work on the platform.Help maintain documentation of agents, workflows, data sources, and permissions.Support audit readiness by ensuring configurations are well-documented and aligned with enterprise standards.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree (recent graduate or graduating by start date) in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.Strong academic record with coursework or projects involving AI, machine learning, data management, or enterprise systems.

Required Skills

Demonstrated interest in applied AI, enterprise search, or knowledge management.Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar platforms through coursework, internships, or personal projects.Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.Analytical mindset with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured steps.Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve and learning is continuous.High attention to detail and a willingness to iterate.

Preferred Qualifications

Internship or co-op experience in an IT, digital transformation, or consulting environment.Exposure to enterprise platforms such as SharePoint, Confluence, Salesforce, or Smartsheet.Experience building workflows, automation, or no-code/low-code solutions (e.g., Power Automate, Zapier, or similar).Familiarity with concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, prompt design, or agent orchestration.Experience creating documentation, training materials, or knowledge base content.

What You Will Learn

How enterprise AI platforms work in practice — not just demos, but real workflows serving real users.How to build and refine AI agents using Glean’s Agent Builder, including multi-step orchestration, branching logic, and human-in-the-loop approval patterns.How to structure and curate knowledge so that AI delivers accurate, relevant, and governed results.How a consulting and engineering firm captures expertise from projects and turns it into reusable IP.How to work across technical and business teams to identify opportunities, prototype solutions, and drive adoption.

Here’s What You’ll Get

Highly competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision InsuranceFlexible Spending or Health Savings AccountsUnlimited Vacation Time10 Paid Holidays12 Paid Weeks Birthing Parent LeavePet InsuranceRetirement Savings: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership PlanEmployee Referral BonusProfessional Development ReimbursementCompany Paid STD, LTD, and Life Insurance

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $65,000 to $75,000, based on experience and qualifications. The role is also eligible for a variable compensation plan.

The posted salary range represents a good faith estimate of the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and business needs.

On-Site Requirements

This position requires a full on-site presence 5 days per week during the first 4–6 months. Following that period, the role will be on-site four days per week, including Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with the fourth on-site day alternating between Tuesday or Friday depending on business needs.

Must be currently authorized to work in the United States.

Policy on Third-Party Unsolicited Resume Submissions: Please note that any third-party unsolicited resume submissions will immediately become the property of Stellix. Stellix will not pay any fee to a submitting employment agency, person, or entity unless a signed agreement is established.

Please Note: Stellix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

rows.title: Data Automation Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Company Overview:Cerulli Associates (CA) is a research and consulting firm, headquartered in Boston, specializing in product and distribution analysis for the global asset management industry. Since 1992, we have blended primary research and data analysis to bring perspective to current market conditions and forecasts for future developments. With a suite of research publications, an interactive data platform, and custom research and consulting offerings, we provide financial services firms with unparalleled guidance in strategic positioning and new business development.
Cerulli Associates is a 2023, 2024, and 2025 Boston Globe Top Places to Work. We are proud to be recognized for our outstanding employee engagement, management, work-life balance, and benefits.
Our clients include virtually all the top 50 global asset management firms, as well as industry service providers, management consulting companies, banks, broker/dealers, insurance companies, investment consulting firms, and private equity firms.
Position Overview:The Data Automation Analyst will help expand and strengthen Cerulli Associates’ data automation capabilities. Their primary focus will be on reusable data-processing, benchmarking, reporting, and validation workflows that support the firm’s research, publishing, and consulting work.
The successful candidate will combine hands-on technical implementation with careful analytical judgment. This person will work within an evolving modern data environment, contribute to the adoption of stronger data and development practices, and help improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of Cerulli’s data products and workflows. This role will help strengthen the reliable, reusable data foundation needed for analytics, automation, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.
This role is designed for someone with experience working with real business data and recurring workflows who wants to grow from strong implementation into greater technical ownership and solution development. The position reports to the Associate Director, Data Strategy, and is based in the Boston office. Cerulli operates a hybrid work model, with employees working in the office two days per week.
Responsibilities and Duties:Build, run, validate, and improve reusable data automation and reporting workflowsUse Python and SQL to transform, reconcile, and prepare data for analysis and business deliverablesContribute to cloud-based data pipelines, transformation models, notebooks, and configuration-driven processesDevelop and improve automated checks, regression tests, diagnostics, and validation proceduresInvestigate data and workflow issues through structured root-cause analysis and implement practical correctionsStandardize and align data across reporting periods to support consistent historical analysisMaintain clear technical documentation, process guides, configuration files, and data definitionsPartner with research analysts, Editorial, survey specialists, IT, and other stakeholders to understand workflow requirements and validate outputsIdentify recurring issues, edge cases, and opportunities that should become shared logic, tests, or reusable enhancementsCompare implementation options, communicate tradeoffs, and constructively identify risks, gaps, or assumptions requiring reviewSupport selected improvements to data access, data products, pipeline performance, and AI-assisted data experiences as priorities evolve
Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data analytics, information systems, statistics, or a related field2 to 4 years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, data engineering, process automation, business intelligence, or a related field; candidates with at least 1 year of especially relevant experience may be consideredStrong fundamentals in Python and SQLAbility to troubleshoot systematically and communicate findings clearlyAbility to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, ask effective questions, and challenge assumptions constructivelyExperience with dbt, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Git, or similar data platforms and development practices is preferredExperience with survey data, longitudinal data, wide datasets, configurable reporting, or automated document generation is preferredExperience with financial services, market research, publishing, consulting, or data products is a plus
Salary:$80,000 – $100,000

rows.descriptionText:
Essential Functions

Lab Manager

 Ensure that the Analytical Development (AD) team adhere to lab safety guidance and waste disposal guidance. Be the point of contact with EHHS on behalf of the AD team. Oversee inventory management such as purchasing, storing, and allocating of new laboratory equipment and supplies. Develop and manage a lab request intake and triage system (e.g., via Microsoft Teams or Smartsheet) to collect non-urgent requests, coordinate prioritization with lab managers and key stakeholders, and ensure timely follow-through while improving workflow efficiency and reducing ad hoc interruptions.

Research Associate

 Execute functional potency bioassays in support of Analytical Development activities. Perform potency testing using ELISA, other plate-based platforms, and flow cytometry, as needed. Support biologics-related AD workstreams through routine assay execution and data collection. Assist with assay troubleshooting, optimization, and performance trending under manager guidance. Maintain assay raw-data trackers and perform basic data analysis. Maintain clear, accurate documentation in electronic lab notebooks and test forms. Support routine management of assay reagents, consumables, and laboratory materials as needed.

Education and Experience:?

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Cell & Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or an equivalent qualification. At least 2 years of relevant industry or regulated-laboratory experience preferred; candidates with a master’s degree and 0–2+ years of industry experience may also be considered. Preferred experience in the cell and gene therapy space. Experience with sample management and ELN/LIMS systems.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

 Experience with a variety of biology lab equipment (e.g., multi-channel pipettes, centrifuge, microscope, plate reader, plate washer, flow cytometer). Good organizational habits. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Word. Proven problem solving and troubleshooting abilities. Good written and oral communication skills. Ability to work in a collaborative environment with a team.

Pay Rate Range: 30-39/hr based on experience

rows.title: Associate Scientist I/II, Discovery Neuroscience
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated cell biologist to join our Discovery Neuroscience organization. This scientist will contribute to early discovery research efforts focused on identifying and advancing novel therapeutic approaches for Parkinson’s Disease and related neurodegenerative diseases. This laboratory-based role will support in vitro data generation, cell culture-based model development, evaluation of small molecule and biologic therapeutics, and execution of proof-of-concept studies in a collaborative discovery environment. The successful candidate will work closely with scientists across discovery biology and translational functions to generate high-quality data that inform program decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, execute, and interpret cellular experiments to support discovery neuroscience programs.Collaborate effectively with cross-functional project teams to support program objectives and data interpretation.Maintain and perform routine work with primary neuronal cultures, iPSC-derived neurons and glia, recombinant cell lines, and other neuroscience-relevant in vitro models.Support compound testing, genetic knockdown/KO and overexpression studies, assay development, and proof-of-concept studies through careful execution of experimental workflows.Contribute to assay optimization, troubleshooting, and implementation of new or modified in vitro methods.Generate, organize, and analyze experimental data with a high degree of accuracy and reproducibility.Maintain detailed and compliant experimental records, observations, and study documentation.Adhere to applicable safety, quality, and data integrity standards.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Associate Scientist I: Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Neuroscience, Pharmacology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline (no additional experience) in an academic, biotech, or pharmaceutical setting.Associate Scientist II: Bachelor’s degree with at least 3 years of experience in Biology, Neuroscience, Pharmacology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline or MS (no additional experience)Hands-on experience with high-content imaging, immunofluorescence, cell viability and reporter assays, ELISA, qPCR, and/or related cellular biology techniques.Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality data generation.Effective written and verbal communication skills.Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with primary neuronal culture, iPSC-derived neurons and glia, and immortalized neuronal and glial cell lines.Exposure to compound screening, assay development, troubleshooting, high-content image analysis, and mechanism of action studies in a discovery setting.Experience analyzing and presenting experimental data.Knowledge of neuroscience and/or neurodegenerative disease biology.Familiarity with statistical analysis or data visualization tools.

Core Competencies

Scientific rigor and experimental disciplineStrong attention to detail and follow-throughCuriosity, initiative, and problem-solving mindsetCollaboration and adaptabilityCommitment to data quality, reproducibility, and compliance

Additional Information

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs. 

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

The System Engineering Analytics Department is seeking a motivated, creative Data Scientist to apply cutting edge tools and techniques to challenging problems facing the US government. This position offers the opportunity to combine Systems Engineering with Data Analytics to build end to end data analytic pipelines. You will have the opportunity to learn from seasoned data professionals in a fast paced and dynamic atmosphere. You will have the opportunity to make strategic differences and have real long-term impacts on some of the most challenging problems in the government space.

Roles & Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will:

Be passionate about applying data analytics to real world problems.Have an innate curiosity and interest in developing research questions and testing hypotheses with open ended tasking.Work with a spectrum of government sponsors to gain understanding of their challenges, evaluate possible solutions and conduct insightful, actionable analyses.Support the development and application of a variety of analytical models to sponsor challenges, with a willingness to adapt and learn.Present results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all sponsor audiences, regardless of technical expertise.

Basic Qualifications:

Typically requires less than 1 year of related experience with a related Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of related education and work experienceMust be a U.S. citizen with ability to obtain and maintain a DoD clearanceDemonstrated ability to manipulate large datasetsExperience with analytic tools such as Python, SAS, MATLAB, JavaScript, R, JavaData Visualization tools such as Tableau, QuickSight, PowerBI, etc.Ability to formulate complex algorithms and process to solve complex data problemsProficiency in use of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Excel, and WordMust have demonstrated proficiency and strength in verbal, written, PC, presentation, and communications skillsThis position requires a minimum of 3 days a week on-site.

Preferred Qualifications: 

Candidates that possess a current/active US Government clearance are preferredAcademic/ project experience working with databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB)Software Development experience in a shared environment leveraging tools such as GITExperience with full-stack development (e.g. HTML, JS, HTML, NodeJS, SQL, Python, etc.)

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

None

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Secret

$80,000 - $100,000 - $120,000 Annual

Onsite

rows.title: Senior Research Associate, Bioengineering
rows.descriptionText:
WHO WE AREODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. The company serves over 40 million users with its AI-driven online platform, deploying data science to identify consumer needs, and developing solutions in the form of beauty and wellness products. ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE, SpoiledChild, and medical-grade skincare and telehealth platform METHODIQ. ODDITY LABS is our cutting-edge biotechnology R&D center, powering science-backed product innovation through the discovery and development of new molecules, probiotics, peptides, and other biological modalities. Unlike pharmaceuticals, ingredient innovation in the beauty and wellness industry has remained stagnant for decades. We are deploying patented, proprietary technologies and capabilities, including AI-based molecule discovery and advanced phenotypic databases, to understand the biological mechanisms that drive cellular behavior and develop uniquely efficacious products for beauty and wellness applications. Innovations from the ODDITY LABS will power game-changing products through ODDITY’s current brands, as well as future brands.ODDITY operates with business headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, Israel, and a biotechnology lab in Boston. Our culture is fast-paced, innovative, agile, and offers every team member the opportunity to drive a big impact.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a Senior Research Associate to be the hands-on technical anchor for dermatology assay workflows — executing, optimizing, and documenting experiments that support target validation, screening, and translational substantiation. You will work closely with PhD scientists, owning day-to-day bench execution while contributing protocol improvements and training junior staff. This is a high-skill, high-autonomy RA role. Success is measured by reproducible data, assay reliability, and the quality of experimental support you provide to discovery teams.. In this role, you will:Execute and troubleshoot cell-based, biochemical, and phenotypic assays: ELISA, MSD, HTRF/TR-FRET, qPCR, reporter gene assays, viability/cytotoxicity, and flow cytometry.Run in vitro safety packages including genotoxicity, phototoxicity, sensitization, and irritation screens under established SOPs.Support ex vivo human skin explant studies: tissue handling, sample preparation, endpoint readouts, and coordination with analytical partners.Assist with IVPT / Franz diffusion experiments: chamber setup, sampling, permeation sample handling, and LC/MS handoff logistics.Maintain cell lines, reagents, and lab inventory; ensure experiments meet QC and traceability standards.Optimize existing protocols for throughput, reproducibility, and cost efficiency.Draft and maintain SOPs, ELN entries, and raw data packages suitable for internal review and external partner handoff.Perform basic data analysis and figure preparation for scientist-led program updates.Flag experimental anomalies, propose troubleshooting paths, and document deviations.Support an environment that enables a staff of highly skilled and specialized peers to perform biological and computational experiments and promote trust and decision-making.Contribute to promoting a unified office/laboratory culture by organizing and assisting in planning community-building activities.Ensure a clean and safe environment for all laboratory personnel. Enforce and support universal precautions and use of personal protective equipment for all laboratory personnel.
WHO YOU ARE
Bachelor's degree in biological sciences, bioengineering, chemistry, or related field (Master's preferred).4–5 years of hands-on industry or academic laboratory experience in cell/molecular biology.Demonstrated proficiency in multiplex immunoassays, qPCR, and cell-based screening — not solely maintenance-level techniques.Proven expertise with functional assays including reporter cell lines, flow-cytometry, ELISA, cytokine profiling, biochemical assays, and fluorescence imaging.Experience with documentation discipline: ELNs, lab notebooks, SOP adherence, and reproducible experimental records.Ability to work independently on assigned protocols while collaborating in a fast-paced, matrixed R&D environment.Strong organizational skills and attention to detail under concurrent experiment timelines.You have extensive experience with mammalian cell culture, particularly experience with handling primary human cells and immortalized cell lines. Experience with stem cells, iPSC differentiation, various culture substrates, and/or 3D models is ideal.You have prior experience with genetic manipulation of mammalian cells (using either viral vectors, RNAi, CRISPR, etc) and molecular biology techniques, such as nucleic acid preparation, primer design, cloning and Western Blot.Previous experience in processing ex vivo tissue, including histology, transcriptomic profiling, and protein quantification is a plus.You have excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience working with a diverse range of stakeholders.You have a strong attention to detail and are committed to maintaining ODDITY LABS’ high standards and scientific rigor.You are willing to learn new skills as needed to help the team be as successful as it can be.You are an independent problem solver, consistently thinking out of the box and taking the initiative to take the next step without instruction.You are a hard worker with a high level of accountability. You hold yourself to high standards but also expect those around you to as well.
WHAT WE OFFER
Competitive compensation and benefits package.This position will consider and sponsor candidates on a visa (OPT, STEM OPT, H1B, TN).This position is in-office in our Cambridge, Massachusetts office and laboratory.The salary for this position is negotiable and commensurate with experience.Note: We’re currently hiring for many roles! Not the right fit, but interested in another position? Contact us olabs.jobs@oddity.com

rows.title: Associate Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

MITRE’s Systems Performance and Evaluation Department is charged to solve some of our nation's most critical challenges in delivering services to citizens throughout defense and intelligence, aviation, homeland security, the judiciary, healthcare, and cybersecurity domains.

Job Description:

This is an opportunity for an Associate Data Scientist with an interest in advancing and applying innovative data science and analytical techniques to help solve some of our nation's most critical challenges. We are looking for highly motivated, adaptive, and self-directed candidates with motivation to join our technical workforce, expand their technical skills and capabilities, and grow our work supporting the development and deployment of nationally important solutions through Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Model-Based Systems Engineering, Digital Engineering, Systems Architecture and Requirements Engineering, and System-of-Systems and Systems Thinking practices.

As an Associate Data Scientist, you will leverage and grow your analytical, mathematical, data science, and systems engineering expertise to support the analysis, design, implementation, and integration of enterprise systems and systems-of-systems, as well as mission analysis for federal agencies.

Specific responsibilities may include:

Using your understanding of data science, systems and mission engineering, quantitative methods, and an awareness of sponsor needs to determine areas where MITRE can have an impactApplying modern methods and tools such as Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Model-Based Systems Engineering, Digital Engineering, Mission Engineering, and Mathematical Modeling to assess capability needs, requirements, architectures, designs, performance constraints and gaps, proposed changes, and verification and test approachesEvaluating and comparing alternative architectures and approaches using qualitative and quantitative techniques; exploring large trade-spaces and analyzing trade-offsIdentifying and developing metrics and analytical methods to measure and analyze relevant system and data properties, such as robustness, resiliency, interoperability, quality, and maintainabilitySupporting requirements management, interface management, and architecture change management processesPerforming data analysis, modeling, and system design and development, including software development, systems modernization, and architectureSupporting multiple tasks across several government-sponsored projects in a small- to large-team environment

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical fieldFamiliarity with programming languages and analytical tools such as Python and MATLABFamiliarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Digital Engineering (DE) conceptsExperience with statistical analysis, data analysis, and modelingInterest in complex, multi-disciplinary data and analytical problemsWillingness and ability to learn new tools and concepts in a variable environment of government sponsorsMust be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires a minimum of 3 days a week on-site. 

Preferred Qualifications:

Preference given to qualified candidates with active clearanceAdvanced degree in related field of studyExperience with multi-disciplinary modeling and simulation (physics-level, engineering-level and/or socio-technical-level)Experience with Digital Engineering integration through internship, research, or academic projects

This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s):

None

This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s):

Secret

$80,000 - $100,000 - $120,000 Annual

Onsite

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning), major sports franchises (X Games, Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).
We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.
The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.
Who You Are:You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any questionYou bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basisYou are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plusYou communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaningYou have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus
What You’ll Do:Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.
Work EnvironmentGupta Media is an office-first organization.
Our CommitmentAt Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.
CompensationAt Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.
We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.
